name: Vighnaharta Ganesh
description: Vighnaharta Ganesh showcases the journey of the deity Ganesha and presents a magical visual extravaganza with impeccable production design, celestial costumes and ingenious audio-visual experience through Motion Capture technology. This technology will make the emotional journey of how Ganesha transformed from being an ostracized child to "Prathamesh" amongst Gods, a more endearing and realistic experience. Motion Capture technology and animatronics which will be used for the first time on Indian Television, after being extensively used in Hollywood. This technology will replace the age old depiction of Lord Ganesha with an inert mask and bring alive the detailed life-like movements and facial expressions to the fore giving the viewers a delightful visual treat. This magnum opus is supported by a stellar star-cast that includes Uzair Basar playing Ganesha, Akanksha Puri as Parvati, Malkhan Singh as Shiv, Basant Bhatt as Kartikeya and Anand Garodia as Narada Muni.

videos.title: Tarakasura's Wish
videos.overview: Far away from the peace and tranquillity of Kailash, Tarakasura  evokes Lord Brahma. Impressed by his disciple, Brahma appears before Tarakasura , who asks Brahma to bless him with immortality. But, Brahma refuses to fulfil Tarakasura 's demand. Tarakasura  tricks Brahma and requests that he shall be killed only by Shiv's progeny. Brahma grants T?rak?sura  his wish. Devlok is terrified of this prospect as Tarakasura  wants to take over the realm of the gods.

videos.title: The Disfigured Portrait
videos.overview: A worried Goddess Parvati tells Lord Shiva that the portrait of the child she drew has somehow become disfigured. Lord Shiva assures Goddess Parvati that the image is a reflection of what is awaiting her in the near future. When Lord Shiva informs her that  they will have a second child soon, Goddess Parvati asks him about the promise he had made to the Devas.

videos.title: Vishnu Grants Parvati Her Wish
videos.overview: Shiv promises Parvati that her fast will not be broken because of him in the future again. Parvati goes to a secluded spot and begins her tapasya. Vishnu appears before Parvati and fulfils her wish: Parvati will bear a child who bears all the qualities of the Shiv, Vishnu, and Brahma.

videos.title: The Birth of Sri Ganesh
videos.overview: Goddess Parvati's fury brings cataclysmic events upon the entire universe. Lord Vishnu and Lord Brahma urge Goddess Parvati to keep herself calm and await Lord Shiva at Kailas. Lord Vishnu assures her that she will bring Lord Shiva back from Gajasur's captivity. Later, at Kailas, Goddess Parvati moulds a human figure from mud.

videos.title: Shani Dev's Curiosity
videos.overview: After the birth of Ganesh, Parvati sees that her son is blessed with the powers of the Tridev. The disciples of Mahadev, meet Vishnu, who informs them that no one can defeat Gajasur. Meanwhile, Shani Dev learns about Parvati's son, Ganesh. He learns that the Devlok is eager to catch a glimpse of Ganesh. Shani Dev also wants to see Ganesh out of curiosity. What will happen when Shani Dev meets Ganesh?

videos.title: Shani Dev Meets Ganesh
videos.overview: Shani Dev is eager to see Ganesh. Meanwhile, Parvati is waiting for Mahadev to arrive and meet his son, Ganesh. Then, Shani Dev arrives in Kailash to see Ganesh. Chandradev informs Shani Dev that he can see Ganesh through his reflection in the water. But, upon seeing his reflection, Shani Dev makes the mistake of coming in front of Ganesh.

videos.title: Parvati's Durga Avatar
videos.overview: Shani Dev realises his mistake but its too late as the curse takes an effect on Ganesh. He tries to escape but Parvati catches hold of Shani Dev. Parvati takes the avatar of Durga to teach a lesson to Shani Dev. After punishing Shani Dev, Parvati pacifies Ganesh. Later. Parvati anticipates the arrival of Mahadev and asks Ganesh not to allow anyone to step inside.

videos.title: Mahadev Arrives At Kailash
videos.overview: Parvati bestows powers on Ganesh to equip with powers that can keep the forces of evil at bay. Then, Mahadev arrives at Kailash but Ganesh refuses to let him inside. Ganesh is oblivious of Mahadev's identity and naively questions him about it. Mahadev's disciples are enraged by Ganesh's behaviour.

videos.title: Lord Ganesha's War Of Words With Nandi
videos.overview: When Shiva arrives at the doorstep of Kailash, Ganesh refuses to let him in.  Displeased, Shiva is forced to go back along with Nandi. Later, Nandi tries to politely convince him and lure him into eating fruits and sweets. But Ganesha continues to guard the door, infuriating Nandi and Shiva.

videos.title: Ganesh Stands His Ground
videos.overview: The disciples of Mahadev urge Ganesh to let them inside but Ganesh refuses to do so. Ganesh uses the powers bestowed on him by Parvati to counter the attacks from Mahadev's disciples. Ganesh proves invincible as his powers are too strong the inhabitants of Kailash.

videos.title: Mahadev Isn't Pleased With Ganesh
videos.overview: Ganesh fights off every attack from the disciples of Mahadev. The disciples approach Mahadev and plead with him to take matters onto his own hands. Mahadev does not take the insult of his disciples lightly.

videos.title: Indra Confronts Ganesh
videos.overview: While Parvati remains oblivious of the events outside her abode, Ganesh fights off the attacks from the Gods of the Devlok. Saraswati asks Brahma to reveal Ganesh's identity to the Gods. Ganesh is angered when he is attacked by Indra.

videos.title: Ganesh Angers Mahadev
videos.overview: Yama confronts Ganesh in an attempt to overpower him using his divine powers. But, his powers are no match for Ganesh, who has been bestowed with powers from Parvati herself. Then, Bharma, himself arrives with Vishnu to persuade Ganesh to drop his guard. But, things go out of hand when Ganesh attacks Bharma.

videos.title: Ganesh's Beheading
videos.overview: Mahadev is forced to unleash his wrath upon Ganesh as the naive son of Parvati is refusing to let his guard down and let the disciples of Mahadev inside. After Ganesh makes the mistake of attacking Brahma and Vishnu, Mahadev decides to end it all for Ganesh. After the cataclysmic event comes to an end, Mahadev and the Gods realise that Ganesh was Parvati's son.

videos.title: Ardhnarishwar Incarnation
videos.overview: Yamraj appears before Ganesha and tells him that he no longer has the right to live on earth. Ganesha refuses to leave earth, saying that Goddess Parvati needs his presence. An infuriated Yamraj forcefully tries to take Ganesha to the Yamlok. Yamrajs act incense Goddess Parvati and Lord Shiva, who take the form of Ardhnarishwar.

videos.title: Parvati's Rudra Roop
videos.overview: Mahadev reveals to Parvati that he has beheaded Ganesh. Parvati breaks down in tears. She blames the Gods for forcing Ganesh to sacrifice his life to keep his vows. The rage turns Parvati into a vengeful avatar and she takes on the Rudra Roop.

videos.title: Will Mahadev Bring An End To The Destruction?
videos.overview: The Gods fear that Parvati's Rudra Roop will bring only destruction and death to the world. Parvati is determined to kill all the Gods who caused the death of Ganesh. The powers of the Gods are no match in front of Parvati's divine forces. To bring an end to destruction, Parvati asks Mahadev to bring Ganesh back from death.

videos.title: The Curse That Led Mahadev To Behead Ganesh
videos.overview: Mahadev assures Parvati that he will bring back Ganesh from death. Parvati brings an end to the destruction and then Maharishi Kashyap appears before Parvati and informs her that Ganesh's death is a result of his curse. Then, Mahadev asks the Gods to find a suitable head to fit Ganesh's decapitated body.

videos.title: Ganesh's Rebirth
videos.overview: The Gods find a new born whose head is pointing towards the south. But, the new born is no human but an elephant. Then, Yamraj appears before Lord Vishnu and informs that he has come to take the newborn's life. After Yamraj takes the soul of the new born elephant, Lord Vishnu arrives in Kailash and informs Mahadev, who then breathes life into Ganesh.

videos.title: Ganesh Is Reborn
videos.overview: Mahadev breathes life into Ganesh but, Parvati, seeing that her son is now unrecognizable, and does not want to accept him. Ganesh, too, is unaware of his new identity. Mahadev informs Ganesh that he is his son and he was forced to behead him to bring an end to his arrogant behaviour which caused much displeasure to the Gods.

videos.title: Motherly Love
videos.overview: The Gods are worried that Parvati has still not accepted Ganesh as her son. Mahadev informs Brahma that fate will take its own course and eventually things will fall into place. Meanwhile, Parvati remembers the moments she spent with her son, while Ganesh tries his best to evoke the same motherly love Parvati felt earlier. Then, Ganesh decides to bring a fruit that grows on the top of the mountain for Patvati. However, while doing so, Ganesh loses balance and falls from the top of the mountain.

videos.title: Brahma's Boon
videos.overview: Ganesha's love for his mother, Parvati, melts her heart and she finally accepts Ganesh. Parvati appreciates the beauty that lies within Ganesh. Brahma announces that Ganesha's birth has rid the world of evil and gives him a boon, that he will be called as Mangal Murti from now onwards.

videos.title: A New Threat To Ganesh
videos.overview: Sindhura hears about the celebrations in Kailash and decides to find out about it. Meanwhile, all Gods arrive at Mahadev's abode to bless Ganesh. Sindhura arrives at Devlok and challenges Indra Dev.

videos.title: Indra Dev Battles Sindhura
videos.overview: Indra Dev is worried about the arrival of Sindhura. He confronts Sindhura, who asks him the reason behind the celebrations in Kailash. Indra Dev's powers prove no match against Sindhura's powers. Sindhura overpowers Indra Dev and forces him to talk about Ganesh.

videos.title: Trouble For Chandra Dev
videos.overview: Sindhura peaks into Indra Dev's mind and finds out about Ganesh's identity. Indra Dev tries to attack Sindhura but the Asur overpowers him. Sindhura then sets his eyes on Brahma. Then, curiosity takes the better of Ganesh and in his eagerness to find out about the crescent moon on Mahadev's head, he takes the crescent moon in his hands and starts playing with it.

videos.title: Brahma's Forewarning
videos.overview: Chandra Dev has had enough of the situation as Ganesh continues to play with the crescent moon. Nandi approaches Mahadev and informs him that the crescent moon is with Ganesh. Meanwhile, Sindhura visits Brahma, who informs him that his death will come at the hands of Ganesh.

videos.title: Sindhura's Origins
videos.overview: Parvati notices that the crescent moon is missing. She is informed by Nandi that Ganesh has the crescent moon with him. Parvati asks Mahadev's disciples to ask Ganesh to hand over the crescent moon. But, Nandi is reluctant to do so, forcing Parvati to ask her son. Meanwhile, Brahma reveals the birth story of Sindhura, who is at Devlok to find out about Ganesh.

videos.title: Sindhura's Powers
videos.overview: Ganesh is eager to taste the food kept in front of him. But, Parvati wants him to take a bath first before satisfying his hunger. Meanwhile, Brahma is worried that Sindhura will use his powers, a boon from Brahma himself, to create chaos in Devlok.

videos.title: Ganesh's Fun and Games
videos.overview: Parvati is worried as Ganesh is not to be found in Kailash. She asks Nandi to find her son before he finds himself in trouble. Meanwhile, Ganesh is spending time with Vishnu and Lakshmi. When he leaves, Ganesh takes away Panchajanya. Now, Vishnu has to get back Panchajanya from Ganesh. But, a demon, Vajrantar, is on the lookout for Ganesh.

videos.title: Vishnu's Shell Gets Stolen
videos.overview: Ganesha takes Lord Vishnu's shell and runs away. Laxmi tells Vishnu to go and fetch it from him. At Kailash, Parvati and Shiva are worried about Ganesha's sudden disappearance. But they are overjoyed to see Ganesha when he comes back from Vaikunth with a shell. Vajrantak makes an evil plan to kill Ganesha when he sees him running with the shell. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Ganesh Swallows Vishnus Conch
videos.overview: Parvati and Lord Vishnu are worried when Ganesh swallows Lord Vishnu's conch. Shiva, on the contraray, doesn't panic. In order to get his shell back, he devises a trick. When he begins to do multiple situps, Ganesh starts laughing uncontrollably, which results in the shell coming out of his mouth.

videos.title: Lord Ganesha's Trip To Brahma Lok
videos.overview: Parvati is worried when she is unable to find Ganesh. But Shiva consoles her and tells her that he must be playing around. Meanwhile, Ganesh goes to Brahma Lok and plays the veena for Brahma Dev and Saraswati. Shiva hears Ganesh's soothing music and is happy. He requests him to come back. Will Ganesh head back to Kailash?

videos.title: The Dangerous Game
videos.overview: Ganesh's new wooden toy comes alive. The demon, who has taken the form of the toy, takes Ganesh on a ride with an intention to harm him. But, Ganesh learns of the demon's malicious intentions and comes up with an idea to escape unhurt.

videos.title: Vighnaharta Ganesh
videos.overview: Parvati orders Nandi to find Ganesh before he lands into trouble yet again. Meanwhile, the demon tries to harm Ganesh using his powers, but it proves futile in front of Ganesh's powers. During their search for Ganesh, Parvati and Mahadev's disciples find Ganesh and take him back to Kailash. Meanwhile, Indra Dev is informed about Ganesh's naming ceremony, but he refuses to attend it.

videos.title: Sindhura's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Parvati is eagerly awaiting for her son, Ganeshs naming ceremony. She wants Ganesh to get ready before the ceremony. But, Ganesh has other curious plans on his mind. Then, she asks her disciples to help Ganesh get ready for the ceremony. Later, during the ceremony, Sindhura arrives at Kailash without the knowledge of the Gods.

videos.title: Ganesh's Naming Ceremony
videos.overview: All the Gods arrive at Kailash for the naming ceremony of Ganesh. Mahadev and Parvati remain unaware that Sindhura has arrived in Kailash. The moment finally arrives when Mahadev names his son as Gajanan.

videos.title: Demon's Ploy
videos.overview: Shani Dev seeks forgiveness from Parvati, who agrees to forgive him and also bless him. The Gods are unaware that Sindhura is with Ganesh. But, Sindhura's powers fail to inflict any harm to Ganesh. Later, Parvati finds Ganesh, who informs her that a demon was in Kailash. To safeguard Ganesh, Parvati asks the Gods to name Ganesh a divinity.

videos.title: Ganesha's Godship
videos.overview: Parvati insists that Ganesha deserves the honor and respect just like any other god for his own safety. Indra dev tells Parvati that it would be unfair to give Ganesha the title of God as there are million other children who live an unsafe life.

videos.title: Kartikeya Meets Ganesh
videos.overview: Ganesh is in a dilemma when Kartikeya arrives in Kailash. Parvati informs Mahadev that he should have supported her instead of Indra Dev. Kartikeya is then introduced to Ganesh, who gleefully gives a hug to his older brother. Kartikeya is disappointed that his mother has given her full attention to Ganesh and not him.

videos.title: Ganesha's Joyride
videos.overview: As Ganesha neglects the warning of his brother and takes a joyride on his brother's Mayoora. Mayoora loses control and flies loud and around and somehow dark forces sense Ganesha's troubles.

videos.title: The New Threat
videos.overview: Parvati informs Karthikeya about the sumptuous meal she has prepared for him. Ganesh feels sad that Parvati has not called him for the meal. Ganesh decides to take matters into his own hands and sits next to Karthikeya. However, midst their moment of joy, the brothers remain oblivious of the threat approaching them.

videos.title: Divine Truth
videos.overview: Parvati is eager to know the reason behind recurring attacks on Ganesh. Then, Brahma and Vishnu appear before Parvati and inform her that Ganesh is no ordinary boy but a divine form.

videos.title: Karhtikeya's Task
videos.overview: Brahma informs Parvati that Ganesh is not aware of his true divine nature. Ganesh complains that no one was worried that he was gone for so long. Then, Parvati treats Ganesh to a feast, which is attended by Mahadev, Vishnu and Brahma. Indra meets Mahadev and requests him to send Karhtikeya to defend Devlok from the attack of the demons.

videos.title: Karthikeya's Decision
videos.overview: Parvati informs Ganesh about the activity he has to complete. She takes him to a spot, where he has to meditate. Indra asks Karthikeya to help him defend the Devlok. But, Parvati refuses to send Karthikeya along with Indra.

videos.title: The Attack of the Demons
videos.overview: Ganesh finds himself all alone against the demons who attack him. The demons are unaware of the powers bestowed on Ganesh by Parvati. Using these powers Ganesh counters every attack from the demons.

videos.title: Divine Powers
videos.overview: Parvati encourages Ganesh to perform the meditation. But, Ganesh can't resist the hunger. Parvati once again makes Ganesh understand that to attain divine power he has to perform the meditation.

videos.title: Immortality
videos.overview: Sindhura arrives at Devlok and takes the throne from Indra Dev. He demands the eternal potion from Indra, who informs that getting the potion is next to impossible. Sindhura decides to get the potion come what may.

videos.title: Vishwakarma Confronts Sindhura
videos.overview: Indra Dev takes Sindhura to the location, where the eternal potion is located. Vishwakarma refuses to let Sindhura pass through. Sindhura hypnotizes Vishwakarma. Ganesh, who has been meditating, is on the path to realizing his true divine powers.

videos.title: Indra Dev Fights Sindhura
videos.overview: Indra Dev realizes that Sindhura has cheated him. He asks the asur to stop in his tracks but he marches forward. When Vishwakarma and Indra Dev try to attack Sindhura, his response leaves them startled. Whenever they try to attack him, he returns more stronger.

videos.title: Indra Dev's Helplessness
videos.overview: To save his disciple, Vishwakarma agrees to take Sindhura inside but Sindhura does not live up to his word and kills the innocent. Then, he forcefully takes Vishwakarma inside. Meanwhile, Indra Dev approaches Brahma, who informs Indra that he cannot help him. He asks him to seek Vishnus help.

videos.title: Ganesh Confronts Sindhura
videos.overview: Sindhura is just steps away from grabbing the Amrit. Indra Dev stands before Ganesh and requests him to defeat Sindhura. Parvati agrees to send Ganesh with him and asks Ganesh to prevent Sindhura from grabbing the Amrit. Just as Sindhura is about to grab the Amrit, arrives Ganesh.

videos.title: Good Battles the Evil
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati take different avatars, that of Veerabhadra and Kali. Lakshmi is worried that Sindhura might prove too strong for Ganesh. But, Mahadev and Parvati's avatars make sure their son has an upper hand against the demon.

videos.title: Sindhura Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Karthikeya helps Ganesh in his fight against Sindhura. Then, Sindhura unleashes yet another avatar of his, but Ganesh counters his attack and turns it against Sindhura. Later, Sindhura meets Brahma and Saraswati and begs them to forgive him.

videos.title: The Lasting Embrace
videos.overview: Sindhura tries to persuade Saraswati to help him defeat Ganesh. But, she refuses to come to his aid. Then, Ganesh once again confronts Sindhura and decides to teach him a final lesson for hurting Saraswatis sentiments.

videos.title: Brahma's Boon
videos.overview: All the Gods realize the true divine form of Ganesh. Indra Dev begs for forgiveness from Ganesh. Then, seeing that all the Gods have a vahana of their own, Ganesh gets curious and wants to possess one of his own.

videos.title: Sri Ganesh
videos.overview: Ganesh arrives with Kuber in his palace and is greeted by Indra Dev and the rest of the gods. Seeing the foods on offer, Ganesh feels that it will not be enough to satisfy his hunger. Kuber makes the mistake of misjudging Ganesh and assures him that he has enough ration to fill his stomach if need be. But, when Ganesh starts eating, all the food that has been prepared is gobbled up.

videos.title: Kuber's Predicament
videos.overview: Indra Dev insists that Kuber apologise to Parvati and Mahadev. Parvati gives a vine leaf to Kuber and asks him to give it to Ganesh.

videos.title: Parvati's Boon
videos.overview: After interacting with a few sages, Ganesh leaves their hermitage and enters a dense forest. While on his way home, he comes across shape shifting serpents. The serpents attack Ganesh, leaving him no choice but to defend himself.

videos.title: Mushikasur's Menace
videos.overview: Ganesh is attacked by Sarpraj during his visit to Naglok. Not the one to back off, Ganesh uses his powers to defend himself. Meanwhile, Mushika has taken over Devlok and has proclaimed himself as the ruler.

videos.title: Parvati's Choice
videos.overview: Ganesh arrives in Devlok to face Mushikasur. He cleverly devises a plan to send Mushikasur's army out of Devlok.

videos.title: Mushikasur's Life in Danger
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev confront each other. One wants to safeguard her disciple, the other wants to save his son. Mushikasurs life is in danger as Ganesh wants to teach him a lesson for entering the Devlok.

videos.title: Mushikasur's Fate
videos.overview: Parvati and Mahadev end their battle and Ganesh decides to forgive Mushikasur. Meanwhile, Mushikasur creates chaos at a hermitage. Ganesh arrives and asks the sages to continue with their prayers while he takes care of Mushikasur.

videos.title: Ganesh's New Challenge
videos.overview: Ganesh is ecstatic that finally he has got a vahana for himself. All the gods appear before Ganesh and bless him for bringing an end to the chaos caused by Mushikasur. But, as the storm caused by Mushikasur settles, dark clouds gather over Devlok.

videos.title: The Chosen One
videos.overview: Indra Dev and the other gods meet Mahadev and seek a solution for the constant conflict between them and the demons. Narad informs the gods that Vayudev should be the god who should be worshipped above all.

videos.title: The Race
videos.overview: Surya Dev, Shani Dev, Kal Dev, Chandra Dev, Varun Dev, Surya Dev, Yam Dev, Agni Dev all reach the starting point to start the race. They are later joined by Indra Dev and Kumar Kartike and later on by Kuber Dev. Everyone is there on time except Ganesh because of Mushads slow pace. Bhrama Dev announces the rules of the competition.

videos.title: Ganesh's Intelligence
videos.overview: The competition starts and all the Devtas are off to race. Indra Dev stays in lead in Kaashi and Haridwar. On the other hand Ganesh and Murshad are still thinking at the starting point as to how to win the race. Agni Dev attacks Indra Dev and set the way to Hrishikesh on fire. All the Devtas and Devis watch the competition.

videos.title: A Story Of Shree Hari Narayan
videos.overview: The episode starts with Gajanan walking around Mahadev and Parvati on mushak ji. There gajanan, reaches earth and all the important tirth places from where the required things have to be brought, gajanan prays to the tirth places and then he reaches the ocean, there as gajanan reaches the ocean water splits itself and the caves door is opened towards patal lok.

videos.title: Rahu Ketu's Revenge
videos.overview: The episode starts with all gods now heading on their vehicles towards Suryadevs lok in the sun. Gajanan completes the entire meal at Raja Balis place to give him respect for which Raja Bali is very thankful as all the other Devtas didnt touch the food because of their race. Rahu and Ketu are angry at the gods and plan to let no god go ahead.

videos.title: Pleasing Chandra Lok
videos.overview: All the participants reaches Surya lok and takes a gem as per competition rules. Ganesh tells Kartikeya to continue the race as he will join after doing meditation. Meanwhile, all the devgan arrives at the chandra lok and notices Kartikeya and Ganesh are left behind.

videos.title: Fight With Rahu-Ketu
videos.overview: The episode starts with Gajanan angry at Rhu-Ketu. He brings back Mushak ji using his trunk and by pulling him using air. He takes Mushak ji and punishes Rahu and Ketu. All the others gods are still competing in the race as they reach Rishi Shokracharyas Shukralok and then go ahead to reach Brahmalok. Indradev is shocked to see Gajanan already there playing music for Brahmadev and Maa Saraswati.

videos.title: Last Stage of Race
videos.overview: The episode starts with Gajanan drinking all the milk. While drinking the milk, he also starts drinking all the oceanic water. Lord Vishnu is worried that Gajanan might drink all the ocean water. Gajanan moves ahead in the race towards the last step. All the other gods are shocked as Gajanan wins the race and reaches Mahadev and Parvati ji first. Everyone celebrates his victory.

videos.title: Brahma's Boon
videos.overview: Given the powers of Ganesh, which have proved beneficial to the gods against their eternal dual with the demons, Brahma declares that Ganesh should be worshiped before every other god. As the gods rejoice about this, a new threat comes knocking.

videos.title: Brahma's Decision
videos.overview: The episode starts with gajanan having notions of three demons praying in space to his father Mahadev, but he couldnt enter that place, as some Divya shield kept him away from entering. Parvati says that its Tripura and tells Ganesh about the story of Tripura and how it all started with Asur Samrat Tarkasurs death, when Kartikeya killed Tarkasur, his 3 sons, Tarkaksh, Kamlaksh and Vindhurmali all decided to pray to Brahma dev for his wish, they sat and together prayed to Brahma dev and Brahmadev was impressed.

videos.title: Trouble for Mushikasur
videos.overview: While Ganesh is invited for a feast, Mushikasur lands into trouble as he finds himself facing death. Ganesh hears the cries of Mushikasur and decides to rescue him.

videos.title: The Rise of Demon Army
videos.overview: Ganesh ji tricks the demons and tries to stop the demon army from getting raised, with Mushak ji. Ganesh ji tries to consume all the ingredients with the help of Mushak ji. He stands over the volcano to stop anything powerful from getting inside the volcano and covers it with a powerful shield. Gajanan tries to convince Mahadev and Parvati to stop all the disciples as they are the demons but fails to do so.

videos.title: Mahadev's Dilemma
videos.overview: Ganesh approaches Mahadev to find a solution. He is asked to seek Vishnus help to defeat Tripurasur as Mahadev cant help him.

videos.title: Mahadev's Decision
videos.overview: All the gods approach Mahadev and request him to help them defeat Tripurasur. Assured about Tripurasurs intentions, he decides to confront Tripurasur.

videos.title: Mahadev's Journey
videos.overview: Mahadev decides to confront Tripurasur. All the gods gather and hail him before he sets out on the journey. With Brahma as his charioteer, Mahadev sets out on a journey to confront Tripurasur.

videos.title: Mahadev's Anger
videos.overview: When Mahadev returns to Devlok, Parvati informs him that Tripurasur had a upper hand in the battle as Ganesh, who should have been offered prayers to was neglected. Enraged, Mahadev refuses to pray before his own son and walks out.

videos.title: Ganesh's Blessings
videos.overview: Shiv and Parvati worship Ganesh before confronting Tripurasur and with the intent of defeating him. Blessed by his divine powers, Mahadev once again confronts Tripurasur and defeats him.

videos.title: Parshuram Arrives
videos.overview: Parvati Ji tells Gajanan the story of Parshuram and how he came to be known as Rishi Putra Ram. Parshuram was the only one who could wield the great bow, Pinak. Mahadev himself gave him the power and blessings to wield that bow and tells him that hell need it in the future. Parshuram is seen training with his great bow and an axe. Parvati ji tells Gajanan how his family was killed and how is anger will lead to his end.

videos.title: Parshuram's Vengeance
videos.overview: Parvati is upset because of something and when Gajanan asks her what was wrong, she tells him everything. She says that Parshurams parents died and tells her the story how they served food to an entire army when egoistic King Kartavirya Arjuna comes to his ashram. After they have finished their food, Kartavirya asks Parshurams parents to give him their holy cow and he will pay them as much as they want. When they refuse the king gets angry and kills them.

videos.title: Mahadev Pooja
videos.overview: Ganesh tells Mahadev and Parvati that Parshuram might stop destruction listening to Rishi Kashyap talk. Parshuram tells Rishi Kashyap that he realizes his mistake and swears to end the destruction right then. He asks what he should do. Rishi Kashyap says the answer lies with him, he shall take the decision, thinking what kind of future he wants for him. Parshuram says he doesnt want to decide on his own and asks him to accept the charity. Rishi accepts it and asks where he will be. Parshuram says he will be alone far away in Mahindra mountains. He throws pink and then it comes back. He thanks, Rishi Kashyap for showing him right path and says he has important work to return the pink to Mahadev.

videos.title: Parshuram Clash With Ganesh
videos.overview: Ganesh makes the arrangements to get puja stuff for Bal Khea Rishis. Ganesh says he will do the arrangements right now and says I have to do this work without going from here obeying my fathers orders.

videos.title: Ganesh Prevents Parshurams Entry
videos.overview: Parshuram folds his hands and greets Mahadev from there. Parshuram asks do you need my introduction to Mushak? Ganesh thinks he is greeting Mahadev and thinks who is this parshu dharak. He recalls Parvati telling Rishi Jamadagni and his wife Devi Renukas 5th extraordinary son is Parshuram. He tells parshuram that he heard about him from his mum and requests him to accept his pranam. He sings bhajan praising Parshuram qualities. Parshuram nods his head. The Gods in heaven say Ganesh handles him well. Nandi is happy too. Ganesh says it seems you are tired, and says he will bring water. Parshuram says he cant get rid of tiredness by having water. Ganesh asks shall I bring food. Mahadev and Parvati are sitting with their eyes closed while the Bal Rishis do puja.

videos.title: Block Parshurams Entry
videos.overview: Parshuram folds his hands and greets Mahadev from there. Parshuram asks do you need my introduction to Mushak? Ganesh thinks he is greeting Mahadev and thinks who is this parshu dharak. He recalls Parvati telling Rishi Jamadagni and his wife Devi Renukas 5th extraordinary son is Parshuram. He tells parshuram that he heard about him from his mum and requests him to accept his pranam. He sings bhajan praising Parshuram qualities. Parshuram nods his head. The Gods in heaven say Ganesh handles him well. Nandi is happy too. Ganesh says it seems you are tired, and says he will bring water. Parshuram says he cant get rid of tiredness by having water. Ganesh asks shall I bring food. Mahadev and Parvati are sitting with their eyes closed while the Bal Rishis do puja.

videos.title: Ekadantaya Dayavanta
videos.overview: The Episode starts with Parshuram failing to move Ganesh from the way even after using his strength to the fullest.  Krishna ji says this might be the sign of an upcoming trouble. Parshuram runs towards Ganesh with full speed and collides with Ganesh. Ganesh is still standing at his place. Parshuram falls afar and collides with mountain, he comes back and gets frustrated.

videos.title: Ganesh Injured
videos.overview: Parshuram uses bhala and Ganesh thinks it is my luck to see Parshuramji fighting using a spear as a chance to learn from him. Lord Vishnu smiles and Laxmi asks what happened? Lord Vishnu tells that Parshuramji is the greatest warrior for battle but it is also good for Ganesh who wants to learn from Parshuramji.

videos.title: Parvatis Anger
videos.overview: The episode starts with Parashurama breaking the tusk of Ganesh using his parshu axe. Parvati hears the sound of Gajanan screaming her name and gets scared and runs out to find Ganesh. Lord Vishnu is worried about what Parvati will do this time as when last time something happened to Ganesh, she was ready to destroy the universe.

videos.title: Mata Kali
videos.overview: The episode starts with Parvati taking her Maa Kali form as Parshuram is sitting doing pranam. Everyone is scared and think no one can stop Parvati now. Suddenly, Ganesh gets up and calls her. He tries to calm her down and tries to explain everything but she is not convinced.

videos.title: Son Of Darkness
videos.overview: The episode starts with Parvati saying why was Ganesh so worried while he was going? Mahadev asks Parvati not to be worried as her son has already been through so many difficulties and still came back. Parvati agrees with him and decides to give Mahadev and Ganesh a surprise when he is back. Later, a baby is born from darkness.

videos.title: Parvati Leaves Kailash
videos.overview: The episode starts with Parvati thinking about what Mahadev said, she has tears and is worried. Parshuram thanks Ganesh for freeing him from all the curses and sins. Parallelly, Parvati does the pooja of Shivling and by mistake puts wrong flowers.

videos.title: Ganesh Questions Mahadev
videos.overview: Ganesh returns to Kailash and Parvati did not meet him at the door. Ganesh asks that has anything happened to the mother? Mahadev says no, she is fine. Ganesh thinks that he has never seen his father such sad. Mahadev thinks if Ganesh knows he will be very sad, but it cannot be hidden from him. Mahadev tells him that his mother is not in Kailash.

videos.title: Parvati Invites Mahadev on Earth
videos.overview: Mahadev waits and thinks why hasn’t Ganesh come yet? Ganesh is on Mushak ji and comes towards Kailash. He finally lands on Kailash. Ganesh comes and says to Shiva that mother has welcomed him with all hearts on earth. Mahadev is happy and smiles and says then should we go now? Ganesh says yes!

videos.title: Wish Granted of Demon
videos.overview: Mahadev says to Vastram that a child who is undefeatable and will live forever cannot be granted to you as a wish. Demon says Mahadev that he has prayed for years, is this what he will get for his bhakti? Mahadev tells Vastram that he can grant him a wish, his son will be all-powerful as he is born. Mahadev grants Vastram his wish.

videos.title: Mahadev's Tears
videos.overview: Mahadev is dejected as Parvati has taken a decision in haste and chose to abandon him. Tears roll down  Mahadevs eyes as he begins to remember Parvati. Entering his abode, he thinks about Parvati and regrets the turn of events. Meanwhile, a young Mahishasur is crying before his fathers dead body and vows to take revenge for his death.

videos.title: Parvati's Avatar
videos.overview: With a vengeful desire to exact revenge of his father's death, a grown up Mahishasur evokes Brahma and demands that he give him a boon. Meanwhile, Ganesh travels to a hermitage to meet Parvati, who has taken an avatar.

videos.title: The Wild Bull
videos.overview: All the Gods have gone to collect haldi. But, Ganesh is feeling anxious about something. Meanwhile, a wild bull attacks the Goddesses. Who will come to their rescue? Watch now to find out.

videos.title: The Asura Ambush
videos.overview: Mahishasur's henchmen ambush the Devis. The Asura's are plotting to take the Devis to Mahishasur for his entertainment.

videos.title: Ganesh Baits The Bull
videos.overview: Ganesh manages to bait the bull. He lures the bull towards him and the Gods are able to wrangle the bull.

videos.title: Nandi And The Wild Bull Face-off
videos.overview: Nandi and the wild bull fight each other. Nandi seems to have an upper hand in the beginning, but the wild bull, Mahishasur, gets up and drags Nandi towards the underworld.

videos.title: The Loophole
videos.overview: The Devs go to the Trinity in search of help. They don't know how to defeat Mahishasur because of the blessing bestowed on him by Brahma. But, Ganesh finds a loophole in the blessing and helps the Devs.

videos.title: The Devi Reveals Herself
videos.overview: The Devi reveals her true self. The Rishi asks the Dev to gift the Devi his weapons and tools.

videos.title: The Devis Are Brought To Mahishasur
videos.overview: The Devis are dragged to Mahishasur. He is happy that he gets to torment the Devis. In order to torment them further, he drags in the children.

videos.title: Mahishasur Is Angry
videos.overview: The Mahadevi has succeeded in making Mahishasur angry. He is on his way to kill her. The Mahadevi confronts him on the battlefield.

videos.title: The Battle
videos.overview: The battle between the Mahadevi and Mahishasur's army rages on. The Mahadevi is destroying Mahishasur's army. Ganesh wants to help the Mahadevi, but Shiva explains him why he should not interfere.

videos.title: The Boon
videos.overview: Ganesh pacifies an enraged Parvati by evoking the mother in her. Parvati holds Mahadev responsible for giving a boon to Mahishasur. Brahmadev tries to pacify Parvati, but to no avail.

videos.title: Parvati's Dilemma
videos.overview: Parvati visits her father to check up on him but he stops her from entering the ashram, as now she belongs to Mahadev, and sends her back to Kailash.

videos.title: Andhkasura Becomes King Of Patal Lok
videos.overview: Shokracharya gives new powers to Andhkasura. While Ganesh is going with Parvati, they cross a bridge made of rocks. Ganesh is worried about Parvati as they reach a forest that has been burned. In Patal Lok, Raja Bali sits with a crown on his head. Parvati makes a Shivling and prays to Mahadev.

videos.title: Andhkasura's Prayer
videos.overview: Andhkasura says he has to pray to Goddess Lakshmi to protect everything he has now. Andhkasura goes and starts praying to Lakshmi. He says the prayer standing on one leg, to impress Lakshmi for a wish.

videos.title: Vishnu's Trouble
videos.overview: Ganesh is trying to convince Vishnu to bring Lakshmi back. Lakhsmi grants a wish to one of her disciples. The consequence of this wish puts the world into darkness.

videos.title: The Impending War
videos.overview: All the Gods gather to make a decision to fight the asur (demons). Indra Dev announces that the Gods should plan an attack. But, Ganesh suggests that they should not take any decision in haste. As Mahadev blesses Ganesh, he wishes that his mother, Parvati, could have been with him.

videos.title: The Footprints
videos.overview: Ganesh follows Lakshmi's footprints. He meets her. Lakshmi tells him to give her regards to Vishnu. Later, Ganesh have a face off against Andhakasura.

videos.title: Andhakasurs Champion
videos.overview: Andhakasur gets a new champion. Hasti the demon. Meanwhile Ganesh itells the Devs about how Andhakasur will rry anything to win.

videos.title: The Asurs Wage War
videos.overview: Ganesh realises that he needs to defeat Andhakasura. He enters the battle and threatens the Asurs. The Asurs are defeated.

videos.title: The Devas Become Weak
videos.overview: The battle rages on. But, the Devas are becoming weak in the face of the Asurs' assault. Ganesh goes on to find Andhakasura, so that he can challenge him.

videos.title: Parvati And Lakshmi Are Missed
videos.overview: Ganesh asks the Devas why they are losing? Vishnu explains to him that since Parvati and Lakshmi are missing, the Devas are losing their powers. Vishnu explains how Jeshtha Lakshmi may be responsible for why the Devas are losing.

videos.title: Ganesh Frees Devi Laxmi
videos.overview: Ganesh frees Devi Lakshmi with Jeshtha's help. Outside on battlefield, everyone's powers come back.

videos.title: Demons Back From Dead
videos.overview: Rishi Shokracharya uses Mrit Sanjeevani and brings back the dead demons to life. Ganesh informs this to Mahadev, as he was the one who gave these powers to Shokracharya. Mahadev tells Ganesh to bring Shokracharya to him.

videos.title: The Tale of Hiranyakashipu
videos.overview: In this episode, Prahlada meets Andhkasura and tells him the story of his father, Hiranyakashipu, who was slayed by Narasimha. Will this have an effect on Andhkasura?

videos.title: Andhkasura Attacks The Devtas
videos.overview: Andhkasura uses his dark powers to attack all the Devtas. Duryodhana is killed by Kartikeya. Ganesh becomes huge in size to defeat Andhkasura. Mahadev finally uses his Trishul to attack Andhkasura.

videos.title: The Darkness
videos.overview: Andhkasura removes his eye bands and attacks everyone with his dark powers. All the Devtas are powerless in his darkness. Ganesh goes to Maa Parvati to take her help. Parvati takes Maa Kaali's avatar.

videos.title: End Of Andhkasur
videos.overview: Andhkasura challenges Mahadev and everyone else that he can never be killed. He almost seems invincible. Ganesh asks Parvati for her help and she takes the Kaali Maa's avatar. Mahadev and Parvati join their powers together to take down Andhkasura for once and for all.

videos.title: Parvati's Test
videos.overview: Parvati prays in front of Shivling for Mahadev to come there. She sits there for hours but Mahadev doesn't appear. Kartikeya and Ganesh decide to go to Mahadev and ask him to come themselves. Mahadev tests Parvati by letting go the water of Ganga from his hair to the place Parvati is praying.

videos.title: Mahadev's Fury
videos.overview: Mahadev opens his dreadlocks and unleashes a fury. As one stream of water gushes out, Kartikeya rushes to control it. When Mahadev opens his dreadlocks the second time, Vishnu himself helps Kartikeya to control the fury of the water. The third time, Ganesh, makes an attempt.

videos.title: Parvatis Devotion
videos.overview: Mahadev releases the water from his dreadlocks to test Parvati's devotion. Ganesh, Kartikeya and Vishnu are stopping the flow of water. Parvati takes the Maa Kaali avatar and stops the water flow from the third dreadlock. But when Mahadev opens his fourth dreadlock, there's no one to stop the water flow.

videos.title: The Marriage
videos.overview: Everyone convinces Lord Mahadev to get married to Devi Parvati again, and he agrees. Katyani's father gives some gifts to Lord Mahadev. Ganesh and Kartikeya are confused whether to join the ceremony from their father's side or their mother's. Mahadev and Parvati get married.

videos.title: The Ceremony
videos.overview: Mahadev and Parvati complete the various ceremonies before they are remarried. Maa Parvati's father gives Mahadev a Rudraksh Mala. Ganesh gives the haldi sent by Mahadev to Maa Parvati. Mahadev and Parvati are getting restless before their marriage, unknown to the fact that new threats are looming around and waiting for them.

videos.title: Dambasura's Plan
videos.overview: A danger looms over Kailash as Dambasura plans an attack on Kailash when all the Devtas are busy and have gone to attend Mahadev and Parvati's marriage. Kartikeya and Ganesh are getting ready for the marriage function. Mahadev and all the Devtas leave for the marriage leaving Kailash unprotected.

videos.title: Parvati's Request
videos.overview: Mahadev arrives with the Gods to the wedding ceremony. When he meets Parvati, she asks to fulfil her request. Mahadev walks out of the room without saying anything. What was Parvati's request?

videos.title: A New Beginning
videos.overview: All the Devs have gathered for the wedding of Mahadev and Parvati. While the wedding is taking place in tranquility, the asurs arrive in Kailash to lay siege to it.

videos.title: A New Threat
videos.overview: Following Shiv and Parvati's marriage, Shiv announces that the site will be turned into an holy shrine for Shiv’s devotees.

videos.title: Mahadev's Disrespect
videos.overview: Prajapati Daksh holds a Yagya and invites everyone there except Mahadev and Parvati. When Parvati questions him asking why Mahadev was not invited, he insults Mahadev. Parvati is not able to handle Mahadev's disrespect and decides to commit suicide by setting herself on fire.

videos.title: Veer Bhadra
videos.overview: Nandi is furious when he gets to know about Sati's death and starts fighting with Prajapati Daksh but is not able to do anything. Somehow, Mahadev gets to know about Sati's demise and is furious at Prajapati Daksh so he takes the form of Veer Bhadra and also calls out Maa Kali and they are set to take Sati's revenge. Veer Bhadra and Narayan come face to face.

videos.title: Veer Bhadras Rage
videos.overview: Veer Bhadra and Maa Kalis rage is seen on the battlefield by all the Devtas. One by one Veer Bhadra and Maa Kali kill all the people responsible for Satis suicide. Devtas are bound to protect Prajapati Daksh so they also enter the battlefield against Veer Bhadra and Maa Kali but could not stand against their power.

videos.title: Mahadev's Grief
videos.overview: Brahma requests Mahadev to cope with the loss of Parvati and restore peace. Prajapati, whose body is decapitated, is brought back to life by Mahadev, who also breathes life into the dead bodies. But will Mahadev come over the loss of Parvati?

videos.title: The Threat
videos.overview: Mahadev continues to tell Ganesh the story of his grief after Sati committed suicide. Mahadev is devastated by Sati's demise and does Taandav holding Sati's body which makes the worlds fall apart. Somehow Vishnu Ji is successful to calm him down. After their marriage, when Mahadev, Parvati, and other Devatas return to Kailash they come to know about Ambasur.

videos.title: Dambasur's Tyranny
videos.overview: After the wedding ceremony of Mahadev and Parvati, all the Devtas return to Kailash, which has been now overtaken by Dambasur and his two sons with the help of a large army. They come across an invisible wall around Kailash and are not able to get through. Ganesh and Kartikey somehow get inside the wall and are trapped.

videos.title: Ganesh And Kartikey's Conquest
videos.overview: After Ganesha and Kartikey are trapped inside Kailash due to the invisible wall, all the devtas realize that they cannot pass through or try to break the wall or else the rebound will be an imbalance in nature. Ganesha and Kartikey decide to give a visit to Dambasur and his sons and teach them a lesson and punish them for invading Kailash, but soon they are surrounded by Dambasur's army.

videos.title: Kailash Gets Destroyed
videos.overview: Kartikey and Ganesh fight with Dambasur's sons and defeat them even after Sunderpriya becomes huge in size and Vishpriya uses his magic. Seeing no other way, Dambasur's sons Sunderpriya and Vishpriya start destroying Kailash which distracts Ganesh, and Kartikey has to fight the demons himself.

videos.title: The Face Off
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikey come face to face with Dambasur's sons, Sundarpriya and Vishpriya and the fight begins. Sunderpriya and Vishpriya only use their physical power but Kartikey and Ganesha use their mental power too. Ganesha helps Kartikey to see the real Kailash which wasn't destroyed. Somehow Ganesh-Kartikey and Sunderpriya-Vishpriya end up in space.

videos.title: Warriors
videos.overview: Karitkey goes on to fight Dambasur and his demons as Ganesh takes Vishpriya and Sunderpriya to space and fights them off alone. Vishpriya tries to beat Ganesha with his magic but Ganesh is too powerful for him. Kartikey fights off the demon with ease but his main concern is Dambasur.

videos.title: Ganesh Ka Vakratunda Roop
videos.overview: Ganesh defeats Dambhasur and manages to humble him. Later, Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati reclaim Mount Kailash after their remarriage.

videos.title: A Lesson For Indra Dev
videos.overview: After Ganesh summons Indra Dev to come and meet him Indra Dev feels disrespected at being summoned by a child and is furious. Mahadev is disappointed in his behavior and tells Ganesh that it's time to teach Indra Dev a lesson.

videos.title: Mahadev's Fury
videos.overview: Indra Dev fails to recognize that the ascetic in front of him is Mahadev. He pays a price for his ignorance as Mahadev in a furious state unleashes wrath on Indra Dev. As Indra Dev runs away from Mahadev's fury, he finds Ganesh, who makes an attempt to rescue Indra Dev.

videos.title: Rishi Agastya
videos.overview: Mahadev's wrath scares Devraj Indra to his core and he begs Mahadev to forgive him and promises him to never get egoistic about his position. Mahadev's raged fire follows him around but then Mahadev decides to forgive him and let his fiery rage drown in the ocean which creates an imbalance in the ocean of which nobody knows about. Mahadev and Kartikey tell Ganesh about Rishi Agastya.

videos.title: Kartikeys Training
videos.overview: Kartikey tells Ganesh how Rishi Agastya trained him and made him the man he is today. Brahma Dev is worried about the upcoming threat from the ocean and doesnt know how to bring up the topic with Mahadev. Kartikey and Agni Dev also tell Ganesh why Rishi Agastya drank all the water in the ocean and why he is not letting the water go.

videos.title: Vishnu Blesses Lopamudra
videos.overview: Vishnu appears before Lopamudra and blesses her. He informs that she will be married to sage Agastya and will become river Kaveri. Meanwhile, in the present day, King Kaver hesitates to marry his daughter to sage Agastya.

videos.title: The Might of the Vindhyas
videos.overview: Sage Agastya and Lopamudra witness the destruction due to Vindhyas trying to show its might. In the wilderness, Agastya and Lopamudra are met by a stranger. Ganesh, who is being narrated this story, is eager to find out the identity of that stranger.

videos.title: Demon Brothers
videos.overview: Rishi Agastya decided to visit and meet the Demon Brothers. Demon brothers try to fool, kill and eat him but Rishi Agastya has some other plans for the demons. On the other hand, the demon in the ocean that was created during Mahadev's rage, continues to grow, eat the other beings and create a havoc.

videos.title: Ganesh Meets Rishi Agastya
videos.overview: Ganesh decides to meet Rishi Agastya himself and make him understand the repercussions of holding the river water with him. Rishi Agatya is in the state of meditation so Ganesh decides to get him out of his meditation.

videos.title: The Birth of River Kaveri
videos.overview: Ganesh takes the form of a crow. Sage Agastya gets irked as his meditation is disturbed due to the crow. Agastya is unaware that the crow is none other than Ganesh, who wants to bring an end to the drought and help Lopamudra take the form of river Kaveri.

videos.title: Mahasankat
videos.overview: Ganesh puts his hand in the newborn Kaveri River and feels something bad. Rishi Agastya feels as if some big trouble is coming for the universe. Brahmadev explains to Mahadev that rage that he left in the ocean, might have given birth to a demon that will destroy everything unless stopped at the right time.

videos.title: The Immortal Jalandhar
videos.overview: Jalandhar who was formed from the rage of Mahadev, comes out of the ocean and follows a lady. When he calls the lady out he comes to know that it was the same lady who saved his life. The lady tells Jalandhar that they should get married as she would make him immortal. Ganesh, Mahadev, Parvati and Rishi Agastya brainstorm for ideas to beat Jalandhar.

videos.title: Mahadev's Decsion
videos.overview: Ganesh comes to Kailash and informs Mahadev and other Devtas that Jalandhar is at the peak of his power as he has allied with another bad power as Rishi Agastya told him. Mahadev now has two choices, either to kill Jalandhar and prevent any future demolition or to wait till he commits a crime. Mahadev chooses the latter and everyone is shocked.

videos.title: The Cave
videos.overview: Jalandar is led inside a cave. There he meets Vrinda. As he embraces Vrinda, she turns into a python. Jalandar manages to come out of the cave and discovers that it was an illusion.

videos.title: Jalandhar Gets His Powers
videos.overview: Shukracharya asks Jalandhar to enter another cave to meet his fate finally, and so he does. After a lot of struggle Jalandhar finally enters the cave and to everyones shock, he comes face to face with Mahadev.

videos.title: A New Kailash
videos.overview: Jalandar creates an entire new Kailash. He believes that he will rule the world and all the other gods are scared or angry at the events that are happening.

videos.title: The New Shiv Shakti
videos.overview: Jalandar reveals his true identity to the Gods and proposes that he is the true Mahadev and his new creation is the true Kailash. The Gods, angry at his imitation and mockery, dismiss his claim. This leads to him showing off his powers and mocks the Gods to an extent where they cannot take it.

videos.title: Jalandhar Overpowers Suryadev
videos.overview: Suryadev travels towards Kailash and decides to make his sunlight reach the top of Kailash but Jalandhar comes in his way and stops him. Suryadev tries to warn him but Jalandhar is adamant to stop Suryadev. Suryadev and Jalandhar engage in an epic battle.

videos.title: Ganesh Saves The Day
videos.overview: After Jalandar attacks Suryadev when he is on his way to Kailsh, Suryadev is not able to defeat him as his powers are supreme than Suryadev. So all the Devtas come to his rescue. They attack Jalandar one by one and then all of them at once but no one is able to stand against him.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Ganesh comes to know that Mahadev is the only one who can defeat and kill Jalandar and comes to Kailash to inform Mahadev the same. Kartikey gets furious after hearing about what Jalandar did to all the Devtas and decides to go and kill Jalandar himself.

videos.title: Ganeshs Plan
videos.overview: Ganesh forms a unique plan to defeat Jalandar once and for all. All the Devtas go and meet Jalandar and act as if they have actually accepted him as the one true God so that he gets overconfident and decide to challenge Mahadev to fight for his place.

videos.title: Ganesha's Persuasion
videos.overview: Ganesh uses his wit to persuade Jalandhar. Persuaded by Ganesh, Jalandhar allows Ganesh and Kartikeya to stay with him. Later, hearing Ganesh and Kartikeya's prayers, Jalandhar gets irked.

videos.title: Vighnaharta Ganesh
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikey meet and provoke Jalandar to confront and fight Mahadev and also tell him why Mahadev is the almighty which makes Jalandar furious. They tell him how Mahadev was responsible for the existence of everything around us and why he is all-powerful.

videos.title: Ganesh's Plan Of Action
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikeya explain Jalandar the origin of Mahadev and how he is responsible for everything around them. Jalandar's ego is hurt which makes him furious. Jalandar asks Ganesh and Kartikeya to worship him. Ganesh wakes up Vrinda and Jalandar by throwing water at them.

videos.title: Signs Of War
videos.overview: Mahadev and Jalandar's battle now seems inevitable after Mahadev gets to know how Jalandar tortured all the Devtas and beat them up. Mahadev tells everyone that he wont go up against Jalandar unless he commits a big crime which disappoints the Devtas and they decide to leave their positions.

videos.title: The End is Near
videos.overview: Mahadev's voice echoes through the universe as he calls Jalandhar's name. He decides to punish Jalandhar. Ganesh knows that the end is near for Jalandhar.

videos.title: Wrath of the Gods
videos.overview: Vishnu Dev confronts Jalandhar. But even Vishnu Dev cannot bring an end to Jalandhar. Then Kaali arrives to bring an end to Jalandhar. However, here too, Jalandhar remains unhurt.

videos.title: Jalandar's Wrath Continues
videos.overview: Jalandar’s wrath continues as Vishnu Dev and even Maa Kaali is not able to defeat him. Maa Kaali cuts Jalandar's body into pieces but Jalandar's body again gets intact which shocks everyone. Ganesh tells Mahadev that only he can end him and his wrath.

videos.title: The Epic Battle
videos.overview: The epic battle between Jalandar and Mahadev starts and Jalandar is thrown by Mahadev through the sun and then again back to devlok but Jalandar seems unmoved as it doesnt have any effect on him. Mahadev, Ganesh and all the other devtas are confused. But then Ganesh comes up with a solution and a plan to kill Jalandar once and forever.

videos.title: Something's Not Right
videos.overview: After a number of attacks by Mahadev and number of plans by Ganesh, they are still not able to defeat and kill Jalandar as he respawns every time. All the Devtas are worried and confused as to what to do next. But then Ganesh remembers something and comes up with a final solution that may help them to defeat Jalandar. What will happen next?

videos.title: The End of Jalandhar
videos.overview: Vrinda chases Ganesh into the depths of the ocean. Then, Vrinda sees Ganesh going inside a cave and follows him. Ganesh makes Vrinda realize the good qualities in her.

videos.title: Enters The Demon
videos.overview: After Ganesh takes Vrinda to Lord Vishnus temple, Vrinda has an epiphany, admits to her sins, and apologizes to Lord Vishnu and Ganesh. This leads to Mahadev killing Jalandar. All the Devtas thank Ganesh and Mahadev for the victory. Two demons enter Kailash and tease Devi Parvati.

videos.title: Parvati's Rage
videos.overview: Two demons visit Kailash and tease Maa Parvati which fumes Parvati with rage and her Maa Kali avatar comes forward. But later on, being asked about it, she doesnt remember anything. Mahadev, Kartikey, and Ganesh are worried and shocked to see her behavior.

videos.title: Holika
videos.overview: Parvati visits the nearby lake to get some water and sees Maa Kali in her own reflection. Vishnu Ji believes that they are going to witness a new avatar of Maa Parvati. Holika is celebrated on Kailash after so many years as Maa Parvati is back. Parvati's story of the 10 events of Maa Kali is recited.

videos.title: Durvasas Rage
videos.overview: Sage Durvasa is in meditation. Indra Dev is on his way to Kailash. He stops upon seeing Durvasa meditating. He informs the Goddesses that Durvasa is known for his rage and can curse anyone. Indra Dev tries not to disturb Durvasa while going towards Kailash but the inevitable happens.

videos.title: Cast A Curse
videos.overview: While everyone is celebrating the festival of Holi on Kailash, all the other Devtas are on their way but stop when they see Rishi Durvasa meditating on their way. Indra Dev tells everyone how if they disturb Rishi Durvasa s meditation, he will cast a curse on everyone. He even cursed Mahadev on his wedding day to Parvati.  But when Rishi Durvasas meditation is disturbed, he expresses to visit Kailash to celebrate Holi with the Devtas.

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: All the gods and goddesses reach Kailash for the Holi celebration and so does Rishi Durvasa after he comes to know about it. When all the Devtas see Rishi Durvasa in Kailash, they get worried about Mahadev and Parvati. And the inevitable happens and Rishi Durvasa gets angry somehow and casts a curse on both Mahadev and Maa Parvati.

videos.title: Where Did They Go?
videos.overview: After Rishi Durvasa cast a curse upon Mahadev and Parvati to live with each other in solitude where no one can reach them, Mahadev and Parvati disappear into thin air. Kartikey is furious at Rishi Durvasa but Vishnu Ji tries to make him understand that there's always a positive side to Rishi Durvasa's curses.

videos.title: Mata Matangi
videos.overview: Rishi Durvasa regrets his decision of casting a curse on Mahadev and Maa Parvati so he decides to help Ganesh and Kartikey find them. Ganesh finds out that Mahadev and Parvati are in a graveyard where they have taken Maatang and Maatangi form. All the Devtas go to the graveyard where they also meet Rishi Markanday.

videos.title: Ganesha's Devotion
videos.overview: Finding his mother in the graveyard, Ganesh decides to invoke the Goddess and bring her to the river banks. Along with the Gods, Ganesh builds a Shiv Ling and invokes the Goddess.

videos.title: Parvati's Ten Avatars
videos.overview: Maa Parvati's new avataar is the Brahma Kali which she takes when she comes out of river and Ganesh starts asking her questions. Maa Parvati tells Ganesh the entire stories of her ten Mahavidhya avataar and everyone listens to her carefully.

videos.title: Vishnu Devs Battle
videos.overview: Maa Parvati comes out of the river Ganga taking the form of Ant-Kaal Mata Kali and gives birth to two demons who attack Vishnu Dev and Brahma Dev. Vishnu and Brahma Dev try to kill the demons but every time they do so, the demons respawned.

videos.title: The Fight
videos.overview: Kali tells Ganesh about the fight between Narayan and Maha Mayas disciples Madhu and Kaythak. As Narayan fights the evil sprits he transforms into the powerful avatar of himself and stops Madhu and Kaythak.

videos.title: Maha Kali's Avatar
videos.overview: Maha Kali explains to Ganesh the reason behind the avatar of Tara. The avatars of Maha Kali led to the formation of land mass and the Sun which was essential for life. As Ganesh asks one question after the other, Maha Kali gets enraged. Indra Dev fears that Maha Kali will unleash her wrath on the Gods if Ganesh asks more questions.

videos.title: The Creation
videos.overview: Maha Kali goes on telling Ganesh the story of creation and destruction and how all the Gods came together, to create the earth as we know it. The birth of the first life and all the myths and history connected to it. Kali answers Ganesh's questions and educates him about life.

videos.title: Kali's Avatar
videos.overview: Maha Kali tells the story of her different avatar and why she transforms to Ganesh and all the other Gods. Kali transform into a more powerful form and all the Gods and Ganesh are at awe.

videos.title: Suffer But Conquer
videos.overview: Daruk and his evil forces plan to take over Earth and destroy all human civilization. As Maha Kali goes on elaborating the mythical story to Ganesh, she talks about how the Yogis and Saints were brutally mistreated, and how they were rescued by the Gods above.

videos.title: The Protector
videos.overview: After Daruk and his evil forces take over Earth and start torturing the saints and the yogis, all the Devtas decide to stop his menace. But when the Devtas attack his evil forces, they are protected by Mata Adi Shakti. All the Devtas are confused and worried to see the protective shield.

videos.title: The War Intensifies
videos.overview: As the story goes, it is revealed that Lord Indra was defeated by the evil enemies. Daruk and his dark soldiers prepare to fight the Gods and bring havoc. Watch how the story unfolds in this episode!

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: As Daruk and his evil forces keep torturing the yogis and the holy saints, Rishi Auruv, the head of all the holy saints comes to the rescue. Rishi Auruv casts a spell and curses Daruk and his forces, that they will never be able to hurt a Rishi anymore.

videos.title: The Gods Above Us
videos.overview: Daruka lures and traps the royal soldiers, and now the Asur King, Daruk has all the powers in hand. Daruk makes a whole island vanish as the Gods try to attack it. Later, Lord Shiva appears.

videos.title: Lord Shiva's Presence
videos.overview: The captured Yogis call upon the mighty powerful, Lord Shiva to protect them against Daruk and Daruka. Lord Shiva takes form and decentralizes the Daruk's power, leaving his Asur soldiers useless. Daruk calls for Maa Kali. Now, Maa Kali has to stand against her husband Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Nageshwar
videos.overview: Maa Kali and Lord Shiva stand face-to-face with their difference of opinions. Finally, they unite to curse Daruk and Daruka that they cannot keep harming the innocent. Lord Shiva sets up a temple, Nageshwar in the midst, as all the Gods watch from above. Asur Samrat appears at the end.

videos.title: Evil Forces
videos.overview: The war breaks in full force as Asur Samrat gathers all his evil soldiers and fights against the Gods. It’s a war of an era, as the Gods try to deflect the dark forces from the Swarg Lok.

videos.title: The Power
videos.overview: Maa Kali tells the story of how Asur Samrat came face-to-face with the Gods. Helpless with the evil forces, Maa Parvati is called upon, and she brings her Maha Kaali avatar and shreds the Asurs into peices.

videos.title: Beheaded
videos.overview: Maa Kali is face-to-face with Akaksh, the Asur Samrat. She summons for all her other avatars, and an army is formed. Kaali's army falls short and she beheads herself, so that her power can be dispersed between her avatars.

videos.title: Ganesh Questions
videos.overview: From the era of the Gods, to their everyday lives. Maha Kali elaborates the facts to Ganesh and answers his questions one by one.

videos.title: Surya Dev
videos.overview: Surya Dev has his powers outbound and off his control. The Rishis and Yogis try to provide assistance but when all fails, Lord Shiva is called upon, and his presence provides solution.

videos.title: Lord Shiva To the Rescue
videos.overview: Lord Shiva is called upon and he appears to be bringing the solution. Maha Kali elaborates to Ganesh that how and why the path to glory was chosen.

videos.title: Devotion
videos.overview: Yam Raj has ordered his dark soldiers to attack and capture Rishi Putra. As the evil spirits try to harm Rishi Putra, he is deep in his devotion and prayer for Lord Shiva. The evil spirits fail, as the power of Shiva protects Rishi Putra. Yam Raj gets furious and takes charge in his own hands.

videos.title: The Mystic Avatar
videos.overview: Rishi Putra calls the Gods with the power of his prayers to protect him from Yam Raj. Lord Shiva and Parvati come together in a mystic avatar to secure Rishi Putra from all evil.

videos.title: Parvathi's Rage
videos.overview: Parvati is surprised to find the plate, from which Mahadev has had a meal, empty. As Parvati's ritual was to eat food from Mahadev's plate, Parvati goes hungry. Her hunger brings out the rage and she decides to speak to Mahadev.

videos.title: Brahma's Boon
videos.overview: Goddess Kali informs Ganesha about Brahma's boon to a demon named Trikur. Impressed by the demon's devotion, Brahma answers his prayers. The demon asks Brahma to make him immortal. When Brahma refuses to grant him that boon, the demon asks for another, which will have consequences in the future.

videos.title: Fight To Survive
videos.overview: Maa Kaali tells the story of the Gods and demons, to Ganesh. She elaborates how the dark emperor uses his power to stop the Gods in their chariots.

videos.title: Sudarshan Chakra
videos.overview: The story of Trikura and the battle with Devtas continue, and Trikura has no plans of stopping just now. He orders the Devtas to address him as their God or else he’ll destroy the Earth and the entire universe. Lord Vishnu uses his Sudarshan Chakra to stop the menace, but even his most powerful attack fails in front of Trikura.

videos.title: Destruction
videos.overview: Trikuras tornado is almost on the verge of destroying the entire universe as the Devtas are not able to control the terrestrial bodies with their power. So Mahadev sends Narayan and Bhrama Dev to get help from Devi Tipusundri who takes Maa Baglamukhis avatar to help them.

videos.title: Good And Evil
videos.overview: Asur Samrat invites one of the Gods to his dark palace. Things turn out quite the opposite and the soldiers are shocked at Asur Samrat's reaction.

videos.title: Trikura Gone Insane
videos.overview: Bramha Dev accepts Asur Samrat Trikura's offer to sit in his court. But later on uses his powers to make Trikura lose his mind. Trikura gets delusional and sees a lioness coming for his life, when his wife comes to the court. Later on, he gets petrified after seeing an ant coming towards him.

videos.title: The Avatar of Matangi
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikeya coax Kali into revealing the reason behind the avatar of Matangi. Before revealing the reason, Kali asks for the creation of Markandeya Purana. Then, Ganesh asks Kali to reveal the origins of her avatars, so that Markandeya can pen the puran.

videos.title: The Transformation
videos.overview: Maha Kali elaborates to Ganesh and the other Gods, the story of her Nataraj dance, and how she transformed into her avatars. As the avatars of Kali and Parvati collides together, the power of her wrath is seen on the planets and universe. All the Gods from above, keep a watch on her and resent the scenario. A throne of water rises up for Maa Kali as she starts the end of her epic.

videos.title: Where Is Maa Mahakali?
videos.overview: After taking Maa Matrangi's form, Maa Mahakali suddenly disappears leaving everyone in shock. Ganesh and Kartikeya try to find her, but fail to do so. They go to Mahadev to take his help, but he is deep into his meditation.

videos.title: The Army Of Demons
videos.overview: Kartikeya and Ganesh follow the sounds and reach a place where demons have gathered in millions. Ganesh and Kartikeya are shocked to see Asur Guru Shukracharya as the head of the crowd. He arranged a competition for the demons, where the winner would become the leader of the demons, and help him attack and win over the universe.

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: The competition among the demons for the most powerful Asur start, and one by one, the demons get eliminated. In the end, only three demons are left who fight against each other. But then, another demon rise among the ashes and start overpowering them all.

videos.title: Pure Evil
videos.overview: As the war breaks loose, the three evil sprits use all their invested powers against the Gods. Ganesh, who has shape shifted is keeping a watch over the war, but things go out of control pretty quick.

videos.title: Leader Of The Demons
videos.overview: The battle between the demons ends and the winner is Asur Shumbh, who becomes the leader of the demons. Ganesh and Kartikeya are almost caught by Asur Guru Shukracharya. He also gathers an armada of demons to rage war against the Devtas. Ganesh gets to know the danger that lies ahead of them.

videos.title: The History Of Shumbh And Nishumbh
videos.overview: The winner of the competition among the demons, Shumbh and Nishumbh were so powerful that all the other Asurs are confused as to how they gained so much power. So, Asur Guru Shukracharya tells them the history of Shumbh and Nishumbh. How is Devraj Indra involved with the history of Shumbh and Nishumbh?

videos.title: Signs Of War
videos.overview: Ganesh tells everyone that after getting impressed by Shumbh and Nishumbh’s meditation, Brahma Dev gave them the blessing of being immortal unless a woman from their own lineage kills them. Asur Maharaj Shumbh decides to declare a war against the Devtas. Ganesh decides to warn all the Devtas about the upcoming war.

videos.title: The Dark Forces
videos.overview: Indra Dev and Ganesh, talk about who to defeat the Maha Asurs. Three Asurs with three unique powers, that can spawn or destroy almost anything. Indra Dev explains to Ganesh that the only way to defeat them is a female spirit.

videos.title: Under The Influence
videos.overview: Devraj Indra accepts the invitation to the meeting for a peace treaty by Asur Raj Shumbh and goes to his premises with all the Devtas to meet him. Ganesh and Kartikeya are shocked and raged by his decision.

videos.title: Deception
videos.overview: The celebration of the peace treaty between the Devtas and Demons continues, and it turns out that it was all Asur Guru Shukracharya's plan to deceive the Devtas after inviting them to the celebration. Ganesh and Kartikeya reach the Pataal Lok to take a measure of Asur Raj Shumbh themselves.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: After Ganesh and Kartikeya visit the Asur Lok to take the measure of the situation themselves, they are welcomed by Shumbh and Nishumbh. Devraj Indra plays a game with Shumbh and Nishumbh, where they both make him believe that he won all the rounds.

videos.title: The Bet
videos.overview: The game between Asur Raj Shumbh and Devraj Indra continues, and Shumbh starts betting on the game and makes Devraj Indra win the first round. But then, he asks Devraj Indra to bet his bearer Airaavat for the next round. Devraj loses the next round and loses Airaavat with it. Everyone in the room is shocked to see this.

videos.title: Pushed To The Limit
videos.overview: As the game between the Gods and the Demons take a new turn, Lord Indra Dev realises that he has been played by the evil Asurs, and he is tangled in such a web that is impossible to get out from. Ganesh is suspicious of the Asur Guru's intentions and warns the rest of the Gods to take their next steps with caution.

videos.title: The Last Resort
videos.overview: As the game between the Gods and the Demons take a new turn, Lord Indra Dev realises that he has been played by the evil Asurs, and he is tangled in such a web that is impossible to get out from. Ganesh is suspicious of the Asur Guru's intentions and warns the rest of the Gods to take their next steps with caution.

videos.title: Ganesh Wins
videos.overview: As the gamble between the Gods and Asurs gets more complicated, Ganesh takes over to save the match. With little help from his pet mouse, Ganesh exposes Asur King's deceit and wins over!

videos.title: The Panchmukhi Avatar
videos.overview: All the Devtas come to know the truth about the Demons. The Demons have now lost the Pataal Lok to Ganesh in the game. The demons try to attack the Devtas, but Ganesh takes his Panchmukhi avatar and warns them to back off.

videos.title: Shumbh's Ploy
videos.overview: Shumbh conceives a new ploy to defeat the Gods. Kartikeya is aware of Shumbh's plan to defeat the Gods. Meanwhile, Ganesh is restless as he wants to meet Parvati. Meanwhile, Parvati is also worried about Ganesh's well-being.

videos.title: Vinayaki Avatar
videos.overview: Ganesh tries to enter the cave, but in vain. He learns that in order to see his mother, Ganesh has to take the Vinayaki avatar. Meanwhile, Indra Dev has to defend the Devlok against an onslaught of Shumbh, Nishumbh and their army.

videos.title: Vinayaki Ganesh
videos.overview: As Ganesh transforms into a new female avatar, she finally gets to meet her mother Parvati. But, Parvati explains to Ganesh why she can't join. On the other side, Gods and Demons are ragging a new war.

videos.title: Ganesh Will Decide
videos.overview: As Ganesh in his female avatar has travelled to meet Parvati, she tells Ganesh that, there is a war ragging between the Gods and Demons and only Ganesh has the power to stop the evil forces. Its now up to Ganesh to decide.

videos.title: Devtas In Trouble
videos.overview: All the Devtas are captured and trapped as they witness Shumbh and his companions take Indra Dev's seat. Asur Raj Shumbh orders Nishumbh to find all the goddesses and bring them to him. Just then, Devi Sachi walks into the premises herself.

videos.title: Devi
videos.overview: As the Gods are getting defeated when fighting against the demons, Maa Parvati with appears to use her poers and bring a end to this unhappy war. Ganesh takes great pride that his mother has come doen to help the Gods in need.

videos.title: Sacred Path
videos.overview: As the dark lord Sumbh captures the Gods, the rest of them are helpless. The war is raging in full power and someone needs to stop it. Ganesh in his new avatar comes for the rescue.

videos.title: Good Vs Evil
videos.overview: Ganesh and Kartikeya fear that the army of the demons will cross the river and wreak havoc on their land. Ganesh decides to stop the demons and gets a helping hand from other Gods. Meanwhile, Shumbh is freezing Indra Dev to death.

videos.title: Shape Shifter Ganesh
videos.overview: As the Asurs slowly but steadily take over the Gods, Ganesha calls for Lord Shiva and Maa Parvati for help. They unite their powers to bring the Asurs down. Later Ganesh changes his shape and size to take over the Asurs once and for all.

videos.title: The War Is On
videos.overview: As Karthik and Ganesh rescue Indra Dev, and take him to a safe location, one of the demons start following them. Ganesh devises a plan to make the demon, follow them to Maa Parvatis layout. Once there Maa Parvati with her powers takes care of the demon.

videos.title: Devi Kaushikis Avatar
videos.overview: Shumbh is informed about Devi Kaushiki by Dhumralochan, who persuades him to marry Devi Kaushiki. Dhumralochan approaches Devi Kaushiki and asks her to marry Shumbh but the Goddess puts a condition. Only if Shumbh manages to defeat Devi Kaushiki will she agree to marry Shumbh.

videos.title: Maa Parvati Strikes
videos.overview: Dhumra Lochan negotiates with Maa Parvati, about her marriage with Asur Samrat Sumbh. Maa Parvati makes jokes with his proposition. She tells him to leave and give up the fight against the Gods. Ganesh takes Indra Dev to a safe location. Asur Dhumra Lochan locates where Devis are hiding with this event, Maa Parvati gets furious, in her rage she tears down Dhumra Lochans of all his power.  Sumbh gets the news and isnt happy at all.

videos.title: Devi Kaushikis Rage
videos.overview: Shumbh learns that Devi Kaushiki has killed Dhumralochan. In order to take revenge, Shumbh forms an army to attack Devi Kaushiki. When Shumbhs army arrives to face Devi Kaushiki, the Goddess unleashes her wrath in order to teach the demons a lesson.

videos.title: Kali Unleashes Her Wrath
videos.overview: Chand and Mund, along with Shumbhs army, confront Devi Kaushiki. Kartikeya is enraged that Shumbh has sent his army and wants to fight on the battlefield. Seeing the demons at her doorstep, Kaushiki unleashes Kali, who tries to bring an end to the demon army.

videos.title: Maa Kali Against Ruru
videos.overview: Chand, Mund and Mahishpondurak summon the rock monster Ruru to fight Maa Kali, as Maa Parvati watches her Kali avatar stand in the battle grounds. The war breaks loose and there is a moment of chaos all around. Maa Kali with all her powers brings Ruru to the ground.

videos.title: The War Has Just Begun
videos.overview: Maa Kali after finishing off Ruru, is now faced with Kal Asur who can transform himself into a bull. A new avatar of Maa Parvati appears, and takes up the fight against the bull. But even after defeating the humongous creature, there are still waves of dark evil Asurs waiting.

videos.title: The Beheading
videos.overview: Chand and Mund summon the Asur army and sends them against Maa Kali, but what they dont know is that Maa Kali, is the source and end of all the powers of the universe, she is the creator and the destroyer of the everything. With her might she stops the Asur army and beheads Chand and Mund. Asur King watches and laments as his forces burn to the ground.

videos.title: An Endless War
videos.overview: Rakhtbeej wages war on Devi Kaushiki but first, he has to face Maa Kali. Every drop of blood that falls on the ground from Rakhtbeejs body creates a clone of the demon. As Maa Kali strikes the clones a chain reaction sets in and an infinite number of Rakhtbeej are created.

videos.title: The Never-Ending Thirst
