videos.overview: Maa Kaushiki calls for all the Yoginis to fight against the Asurs, but as their swords pierce the Maha Asurs body and he bleeds out, new Asurs are spawned from his blood. Maa Kaushika prays for her Vinashini Avatar, and Maha Kali Vinashini appears, she starts consuming the Asurs, as its the only way to fight without bloodshed, but her thirst for blood cannot be quenched.

videos.title: Lord Shiva Is Awakened
videos.overview: Maa Kali is furious with hunger and her thirst for blood cannot be tamed. Ganesh tries to calm her down but Maa Kali in the fit of rage doesnt recognize Ganesh. The Yoginis run to Maa Kaushiki for help. While a new Asur army gets defeated by Maa Kali. Ganesh devises a plan to call Lord Shiv.

videos.title: Peace Is Restored
videos.overview: Lord Shiva calms Maa Kali down, and explains to importance of balance and power. All the gods rejoice as the battle has almost come to an end. Asur Dev laments over his loss and plans for a revenge.

videos.title: When The Sky Rained Blood
videos.overview: Shumbh and Nishumbh, along with their army of demons, wage war against Devi Kaushiki.  Blood rain falls on the demon army to deter them from attacking the Goddess. But, the demons are undeterred and march on.  Devi Kaushiki asks Chandmari and Kali to unleash their wrath on the demon army.

videos.title: The Last Battle
videos.overview: The Asur Lords Shumbh and Nishumbh taunt Maa Kaushiki as a powerless woman. She warns them at the power of a woman is the power of creation and she can bring death upon everyone in an instant. As the asur army gets ready to charge, Maa Kaushiki demolishes them with her bow and arrows. Ganesh, Karthik and all the other Gods watch from above as winning dice roll on their side.

videos.title: Devi Maheshwari
videos.overview: Asur Dev Sumbh has captured innocent villagers and is threatening Maa Kaushiki that to save the innocents she has to declare Sumbh the king and ultimate ruler. Maa Kaushiki and all the gods call for a new Avatar of Maa Parvati. Watch as Devi Masheswari comes to rescue the gods.

videos.title: The Wrath Of The Goddess
videos.overview: Shumbh sees his army falling to the ground as one after the other his men are slain by the Goddesses.  Instead of being deterred, Shumbh continues to mock at Devi Kaushiki. After Shumbh loses his army,  he ridicules the Goddess, which calls for the beginning of the end for Shumbh.

videos.title: The Power Of Women
videos.overview: Asur Dev is ready to fight Maa Kaushiki, he taunts her claiming a woman cannot defeat her as she is less powerful than him. Ganesh and Karthilk get furious with Asur Dev and wants Maa Kaushiki to finish him. Maa Kaushiki calls all of her avatars.

videos.title: Asht Matrika
videos.overview: The Gods have concluded that Sumbh cannot be defeated by a woman. Lord Ganesh uses this loophole and turns himself into Vinayaki to put him down, once and for all.

videos.title: Vinayaka Chaturthi
videos.overview: While Kailash is being decorated for Vinayaka Chaturthi, and all the Gods heading for Kailash to take part in the celebrations, Yamraj receives a warning from Chitragupta about Ganeshs well-being. Yamraj, who is about to leave for Kailash, wonders what dangers lie ahead.  Meanwhile,  all the Gods arrive at Kailash with presents for Ganesh.

videos.title: Eternal Source Of Power
videos.overview: It's Ganesh's birthday, and all the Gods are excited to surprise, Lord Shiv and Maa Parvati present their son with beautiful gifts and there is a mood for celebration. On the other side, someone is trying to reach for Lord Shiva claiming to be his long lost son.

videos.title: The Arrival
videos.overview: The celebration continues with all the unique rituals and customs, and Ganesh is more than happy to have his family around him. On the other side Lord Shivas supposed ward Bhom is here to meet his father.

videos.title: The Dilemma
videos.overview: Yamraj wants to inform Parvati about Chitraguptas warning but fails to muster the courage. While on the way out of Kailash, Yamraj asks his wife to return home and he decides to meet Parvati to inform about the forewarning.

videos.title: Chandra Devs Words
videos.overview: After the grand birthday feast Ganesh rides on Mushak Ji. From the sky above Chandra Dev comments on Ganeshs eating habbits, enraged with fury, Ganeshs stomach tears apart. Lord Shiva and Maa Kaushiki and all the other Gods are deeply hurt and annoyed with what Chandra Dev did.

videos.title: Ganesh's Strength
videos.overview: After the mishap, Ganesh rises up to find Maa Kaushiki unconscious with grief. He gets furious and finnaly comes to conclusion that Chandra Dev is responsible for it. With his strength Ganesh blows the dark clouds over Chandra Dev and thus the moon hides within the dark clouds.

videos.title: The Cursed
videos.overview: With Ganesh's curse Chandra Dev is now devastated, whatever he looks at whatever he touches turns lifeless. With guilt and resentment Chandra Dev dives into a water-body trying to hide away. Meanwhile Bhom is trying his best to gain acceptance in Lord Shivas eyes.

videos.title: Power Of Prayers
videos.overview: All the Gods are stunned that Ganeshs curse has disturbed the balance of the universe. While Lord Shiva and Maa Kaushiki along with all the other Gods pray to make Ganesh calm down. Ganesh starts his own meditation to equip himself with more power. Meanwhile Bhom is also trying to reach Lord Shiva and find his calling.

videos.title: Sankashti Chaturthi
videos.overview: Maa Kaushiki makes Ganesh understand the consequence of his wrath, finally Ganesh calms down and forgives Chandra Dev, and claims that from today onwards this auspicious day will be named as Sankashti Chaturthi.

videos.title: Lurking Threat
videos.overview: Ganesh shows mercy and forgives Chandra Dev. He also announces that from this day onwards, worshiping Chandra Dev will be vital for prosperity on Sankashti Chaturthi.  Later, Mahadev is pleased that Ganesh is trying to meditate but Parvati is displeased.  Unknown to them, a new threat is around the corner.

videos.title: Ganesh The Almighty
videos.overview: Peaceful times for the Gods, and all the dark forces have been defeated, but as a human devotee plans to respect Ganesh with their rituals, a dark force from somewhere keeps on disrupting them. Ganesh takes shape in to their ritual and fights the dark force Durh Budhi.

videos.title: Ganesh's Anger
videos.overview: Ganesh slays the demon in an enraged state. His uncontrollable anger echoes through the Devlok. Brahma appears before Ganesha and tries to calm him down. But, Ganesh tries to ingest the creator Brahma.

videos.title: The Flare Of Anger
videos.overview: As the two avatars of Ganesh search to find the source of the wrath and anger Mushak Ji comes to help. After all the hardship Ganesh finally comes gave to face with Bhom, and a new battle waits.

videos.title: Bhom Against Ganesh
videos.overview: As Ganesh and his vengeful avatar reach the source of their anger, they find Bhom standing against them. Ganesh puts up a fight and all the Gods are praying for his success.

videos.title: The Birth of Mangal
videos.overview: Bhom arrives in Kailash. Though he faces resistance initially, he is welcomed with open arms.  Parvathi acknowledges Bhom and gives him a new name, Mangal.  Amidst the happiness, a new threat looms large on Kailash.

videos.title: Episode 271
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha comes up with a plan to establish peace between the Gods and the asuras through Gyanari's son, Subodh. On his advice, Kartikeya agrees to become Subodh's guru. Later, Lord Ganesha helps Kartikeya enter Subodh's life.

videos.title: Episode 272
videos.overview: Kartikeya starts grooming Subodh, which brings about a positive change in the latter's behaviour. He later introduces Subodh to a path towards the worship of Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 273
videos.overview: On Gyanari's orders, his soldiers try to capture Kartikeya but in vain. After his escape, Gyanari simmers with anger and decides to punish Subodh for his devotion towards Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 274
videos.overview: Despite Gyanari's torture, Subodh refuses to give up on his devotion towards Lord Ganesha. When Gyanari tries to kill Subodh, Dakini intervenes and saves his life. She later tries to convince her son to stop worshipping Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 275
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha appears in the form of 'Mahodar' and ensures that Subodh does not get killed by Gyanari. However, he is not aware of a bigger threat that is looming large on him and the other gods.

videos.title: Episode 276
videos.overview: After Gyanari's death, Dakini's sworn brother Arnalasur battles with Lord Ganesha. Despite getting killed, Arnalasur comes back to life. At Kailash, Lord Shiva then reveals to other gods that Arnalasur is the love child of Yamraj, the god of death.

videos.title: Episode 277
videos.overview: After swallowing Arnalasur, Lord Ganesha feels severe pain in his stomach caused by the immense body heat. This happens as Arnalasur's body is made of lava. Due to the unbearable pain, Lord Ganesha continues to scream while the gods feel helpless.

videos.title: Episode 278
videos.overview: All the gods try several remedial measures to help ease Lord Ganesha's pain but manage to provide only a short-term relief. When Goddess Parvati reaches the venue, everyone fears her wrath. However, she comes up with a solution instead.

videos.title: Episode 279
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha is curious about how the strands of the Durva grass eased his pain while all other remedial measures did not work. Parvati then narrates the story of an ordinary Brahmin girl named Durva, and her devotion towards Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 280
videos.overview: Mushakji gets scared after Lord Ganesha narrates a horror story to him. Soon, both fall asleep, unaware that they are under a threat from an unknown force. Later, Mushakji finds himself in trouble after he gets attacked while drinking water.

videos.title: Episode 281
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha is taken aback after the unknown force reveals that it is the spirit of Gyanari, an asura whom he had killed in the past. Later, Kartikeya comes up with a solution to help Gyanari's trapped spirit.

videos.title: Episode 282
videos.overview: After narrating the story of Kashi, which is dear to Lord Shiva, Kartikeya plans to visit the city with Lord Ganesha to help Gyanari's spirit attain salvation. They also decide to call Subodh to the city to help them accomplish the task.

videos.title: Episode 283
videos.overview: Goddess Varahi, the protector of Kashi, starts fuming with rage and refuses to let Gyanari's spirit enter the city. To calm her down, Lord Ganesha chants her mantra while Subodh, Mushakji and Kartikeya pray with folded hands.

videos.title: Episode 284
videos.overview: While narrating the significance of the Kashi Vishwanath temple to Lord Ganesha, Kartikeya reveals that Lord Shiva and Parvati reside there in a different form. Later, a sage advises them to take Gyanari's spirit to the river Ganga for his salvation.

videos.title: Episode 285
videos.overview: While proceeding towards the river Ganga, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya are in a fix as an agitated Kalbhairav attacks Gyanari's spirit. Eventually, they are allowed, but soon the river Ganga turns ferocious and refuses to let Gyanari's spirit step in.

videos.title: Episode 286
videos.overview: After narrating the story of the Pishachmochan ghat, Ganga asks Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya to visit it to free Gyanari's spirit. Midway, the brothers hear Parvati sobbing and learn about the shocking decision made by the King of Kashi.

videos.title: Episode 287
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha prevents Kartikeya from punishing the King of Kashi for barring Lord Shiva from entering the city. Later, Goddess Parvati asks them to consider both sides of the story and narrates a past incident which led to the decision.

videos.title: Episode 288
videos.overview: Goddess Parvati reveals that ever since Lord Shiva departed from Kashi, all other gods also left, leaving her alone. She advises Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya to take Gyanari's spirit to Gaya for his salvation and narrates the story of Gayasura.

videos.title: Episode 289
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya inform Gyanari's spirit that they need to visit Gaya for his salvation. After reaching Gaya, they find out the significance of the 'Shradh' ritual.

videos.title: Episode 290
videos.overview: After entering a new body, Gyanari's spirit is elated but his joy is short-lived as Yamraj's messengers begin to torture him as a punishment for the sins of his past life. Seeing Gyanari's spirit in pain, Lord Ganesha gets worried about him.

videos.title: Episode 291
videos.overview: Yamraj's messengers inform Lord Ganesha that if Gyanari's good karma prevails by the end of the torturous cleansing process, he will attain a position in the heaven. However, Gyanari's sufferings reach an unbearable level.

videos.title: Episode 292
videos.overview: Subodh cries as Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya narrate the punishments that Gyanari is being subjected to. Meanwhile, Gyanari manages to clear the initial phases of his punishment.

videos.title: Episode 293
videos.overview: Maha Ganesh appears before Gyanari in heaven and grants him salvation. Meanwhile, Subodh expresses his gratitude to Lord Ganesh and Kartikeya for guiding him through the difficult phase and helping his father's spirit.

videos.title: Episode 294
videos.overview: As a part of his plan to facilitate Lord Shiva's entry into Kashi, Indra sends two of his most beautiful apsaras to entice King Divodasa. When his plan fails, Indra resorts to violence. King Divodasa then prays to Lord Shiva for the safety of Kashi.

videos.title: Episode 295
videos.overview: An infuriated Lord Shiva is about to open his third eye and burn Indra to ashes for attacking the holy city of Kashi and King Divodasa. While Indra trembles with fear, Lord Ganesha, Kartikeya and other gods pray to Lord Shiva to calm him down.

videos.title: Episode 296
videos.overview: Unable to find any fault with King Divodasa and Kashi, Surya disintegrates himself into twelve parts and makes the city his abode. Indra orders a few gods to take the Yogini goddesses' help to facilitate Lord Shiva's entry into Kashi.

videos.title: Episode 297
videos.overview: Goddess Parvati's words and the divine vibes of Kashi convince the Yogini goddesses to reside there instead of attacking it. Later, Lord Brahma comes to the aid of the gods and poses as a Brahmin to put King Divodasa through a difficult test.

videos.title: Episode 298
videos.overview: Lord Brahma and the other gods are impressed with King Divodasa's dedication and humility during the test. Unable to find any flaws, Lord Brahma decides to conduct a yajna in Kashi. Meanwhile, Durgamasur and his army attack the gods in heaven.

videos.title: Episode 299
videos.overview: After misleading the gods during a fight, Durgamasur steals the holy Vedas from Lord Brahma's abode. While the gods start turning weak, Lord Brahma reveals that only a woman who has not blinked for years can put an end to Durgamasur.

videos.title: Episode 300
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya come up with a plan to facilitate Lord Shiva's entry into Kashi so that he can unite with Goddess Parvati and she can eventually kill Durgamasur.

videos.title: Episode 301
videos.overview: Posing as Gunesh, Lord Ganesha predicts that King Divodasa won't live for more than ten days and convinces him to fast for nine days for Navratri with him. Meanwhile, the Goddess of Vedas suffers in the captivity of Durgamasur.

videos.title: Episode 302
videos.overview: In the form of Gunesh and Kritesh respectively, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya narrate the story of Goddess Shailputri to King Divodasa and Sarla on the first day of Navratri.

videos.title: Episode 303
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya narrate the story of Sati's death and its impact on Lord Shiva to King Divodasa and Sarla. Through his story, Lord Ganesha tries to indicate that separation of Lord Shiva from his wife causes an imbalance in the universe.

videos.title: Episode 304
videos.overview: In order to explain the reason for the birth of Goddess Shailputri, Lord Ganesha narrates the story of Sage Kashyap's son Vajrang, who wanted to establish his rule over the universe.

videos.title: Episode 305
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha mentions how Vajrang's son Tarakasura wreaked havoc in the universe after acquiring a boon from Lord Brahma. He also narrates the story of Daksha's granddaughters, Maina, Dhanya and Kalawati.

videos.title: Episode 306
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha mentions how Goddess Adishakti was pleased with the prayers of Maina and Himavan. He also narrates how she indirectly forewarned Tarakasura about his impending doom.

videos.title: Episode 307
videos.overview: King Divodasa and Sarla discover how Narad Muni provoked Tarakasura by sharing the news of Goddess Adishakti's anticipated rebirth as the daughter of Maina and Himavan.

videos.title: Episode 308
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura got scared for his life and planned to kill Maina and her daughter with the help of his accomplice named Attasura.

videos.title: Episode 309
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha mentions Goddess Brahmacharini, who is worshipped on the second day of Navratri. He also talks about the Tarakasura's repeated attacks on Goddess Parvati, also known as Goddess Shailputri, during her growing years.

videos.title: Episode 310
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha continues with the story and reveals how Himavan decided to take Parvati to serve Lord Shiva, who was meditating in a cave. He also narrates how all the gods eagerly waited for Parvati and Lord Shiva to come face-to-face.

videos.title: Episode 311
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Lord Shiva and Parvati came face-to-face but did not look at each other. He adds that Lord Shiva hesitated at first but eventually allowed to let Parvati serve him, and the gods expected them to unite soon.

videos.title: Episode 312
videos.overview: While Parvati keeps serving Lord Shiva during his meditation, both do not even look at each other for several days. This makes Indra anxious and he enlists the help of Kaam Deva, the Cupid god, to draw Lord Shiva closer to Parvati.

videos.title: Episode 313
videos.overview: As per Indra's orders, Kaam Deva proceeds towards the cave to bring Lord Shiva out of his meditative state. Meanwhile, Kaam Deva's wife Rati fears the possible effects of Lord Shiva's wrath on her husband.

videos.title: Episode 314
videos.overview: While Kaam Deva shoots his arrow towards Lord Shiva, the latter opens his eyes and finds Parvati standing right in front of him, after which he is reminded of Sati. Suddenly, he is hit by Kaam Deva's arrow and chaos ensues in the universe.

videos.title: Episode 315
videos.overview: Fuming with anger, Lord Shiva reduces Kaam Deva to ashes and walks away. Later, Parvati has flashbacks of her past life and recollects that she is Goddess Adishakti.

videos.title: Episode 316
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu and Goddess Laxmi approach Lord Shiva with an offer to get him married to Parvati, the daughter of Himavan. However, Lord Shiva refuses the proposal, much to their dismay.

videos.title: Episode 317
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Lord Shiva announced that Parvati must go through a test to marry him and conveyed the same to Lord Vishnu and Goddess Laxmi.

videos.title: Episode 318
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya reveal that Lord Shiva approached Parvati and her family in the form of a woman and introduced himself as Kantha, an ardent devotee of Lord Vishnu.

videos.title: Episode 319
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Parvati decided to observe a penance to unite with Lord Shiva. He also reveals how she remained engrossed in the penance despite facing several obstacles.

videos.title: Episode 320
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Parvati observed a severe penance in the form of Goddess Brahmacharini to unite with Lord Shiva. He adds that when Tarakasura sent his asuras to attack her, Goddess Laxmi and Goddess Saraswati came to her aid.

videos.title: Episode 321
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya narrate how all the gods were worried as Lord Shiva did not react to Parvati's ongoing severe penance. They add how Lord Shiva decided to put Parvati through yet another test.

videos.title: Episode 322
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha reveals how Lord Shiva approached Parvati amid her penance in the form of a sage and asked her to marry him. He adds that the sage asked Parvati to forget Lord Shiva for making her suffer.

videos.title: Episode 323
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Himavan was happy but Maina was apprehensive when the 'Saptarishis' brought Lord Shiva's marriage proposal for Parvati.

videos.title: Episode 324
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Lord Vishnu sent a gift through Narad Muni for Parvati before the arrival of the wedding procession of Lord Shiva accompanied by his followers and other gods.

videos.title: Episode 325
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Parvati's parents were taken aback by Lord Shiva's appearance and turned skeptical about the wedding. He adds that Parvati tried to convince Maina to let the wedding take place.

videos.title: Episode 326
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha reveals how Lord Shiva appeared in his divine form on Parvati's request and subsequently, Maina and Himavan welcomed him before the commencement of the wedding rituals.

videos.title: Episode 327
videos.overview: After speaking about Goddess Chandraghanta, Lord Ganesha continues with the story and narrates what Goddess Parvati experienced on her first day at Mount Kailash with Lord Shiva and his followers.

videos.title: Episode 328
videos.overview: King Divodasa wonders why he experiences a subtle feeling of guilt after Lord Ganesha completes narrating the story of Goddess Chandraghanta. The following day, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya start narrating the story of Goddess Kushmanda.

videos.title: Episode 329
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates the story of Skanda's mother Goddess Skandamata, wherein Skanda is another name for Kartikeya. He adds that though the gods wanted Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati to have a son, they feared the kind of powers he would possess.

videos.title: Episode 330
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates the story of Kartikeya's birth and reveals how he transformed into a teenager after a brief period of infancy. He adds that Tarakasura summoned Panchasura to get rid of Kartikeya.

videos.title: Episode 331
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya was cornered by Panchasura before reaching Mount Kailash, where Goddess Parvati was eagerly waiting for him.

videos.title: Episode 332
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya used his wisdom to tackle the panchasuras and managed to free himself from their trap.

videos.title: Episode 333
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya got his peacock and received a grand welcome at Mount Kailash, after which Goddess Parvati announced that she will personally start training him to tackle Tarakasura.

videos.title: Episode 334
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya was appointed as the commander of the army of gods. He adds that Kartikeya preferred establishing peace between the asuras and gods instead of waging a war.

videos.title: Episode 335
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya led the army of gods to attack the asuras after Tarakasura disrespectfully rejected their peace proposal.

videos.title: Episode 336
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha reveals how Mahaganpati shared some valuable piece of advice with Kartikeya and other gods before the commencement of their battle against the asuras.

videos.title: Episode 337
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya prayed to Goddess Parvati and she effectively guided him during his battle with the asuras.

videos.title: Episode 338
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya recalled Mahaganpati's advice while trying to reach Tarakasura's magical dagger. He adds that Indra had second thoughts about the pursuit after realizing the impending obstacles in their path.

videos.title: Episode 339
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya and other gods faced several unforeseen obstacles on their way to the secret palace where Tarakasura's magical dagger was kept.

videos.title: Episode 340
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha reveals how Kartikeya used his wisdom to help all the gods find a possible way to locate Tarakasura's magical dagger inside the secret palace.

videos.title: Episode 341
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura set out to destroy Kartikeya and the other gods after learning that they intended to acquire his magical dagger from his secret palace.

videos.title: Episode 342
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kuber found himself in deep trouble while Indra, Vaayu and Kartikeya were at different spots within Taraksura's mystical kingdom.

videos.title: Episode 343
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya freed himself and other gods from the mysterious trap near the secret palace but ended up facing Tarakasura and his ally.

videos.title: Episode 344
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Goddess Skandamata helped Kartikeya in a deadly game of snakes and ladders against Tarakasura while Indra, Vaayu and Kuber were under the threat of turning into trees.

videos.title: Episode 345
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya braved several threats while playing a game of snakes and ladders with Tarakasura to ensure that Indra, Vaayu and Kuber did not turn into trees.

videos.title: Episode 346
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya overcame his negative emotions as per Goddess Skandamata's advice, and won a phase of the game despite being instigated by Tarakasura.

videos.title: Episode 347
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya adhered to the rules of the game and won another phase against Tarakasura with some help from Indra and Goddess Skandamata.

videos.title: Episode 348
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya managed to reach Tarakasura's magical dagger after winning the deadly game of snakes and ladders, and broke it into two parts.

videos.title: Episode 349
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Lord Vishnu visited Kartikeya amid his rigorous training to warn him about Tarakasura's next move in their upcoming battle.

videos.title: Episode 350
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Attasura approached Kartikeya and other gods at an odd hour of the night claiming that Tarakasura banished him.

videos.title: Episode 351
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha reveals how Tarakasura's tricky challenge became the reason for an impending war between the gods and the asuras after Kartikeya offered to shelter Attasura.

videos.title: Episode 352
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Goddess Skandamata blessed Kartikeya and advised him to protect Attasura at all costs before his big fight against Tarakasura and his army of asuras.

videos.title: Episode 353
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Veerbhadra and Mahakali helped Kartikeya and other gods in their battle against Tarakasura and his army of asuras.

videos.title: Episode 354
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha reveals how Kartikeya and other gods left Tarakasura and his army dumbfounded with their unique battle techniques. He later narrates how Surya started losing his energy as a result of an attack from Hantak.

videos.title: Episode 355
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura ordered one of his accomplices to kidnap Kartikeya and Attasura from the battlefield, after which the gods got worried.

videos.title: Episode 356
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura attacked the 'Ashtagajas', a group of eight elephants responsible for maintaining the balance of the earth, while his accomplices battled other gods.

videos.title: Episode 357
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Veerbhadra and Mahakali battled the asuras while Tarakasura managed to disturb the balance of the earth by hurting the 'Ashtagajas' before proceeding to attack Attasura.

videos.title: Episode 358
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya managed to protect Attasura, after which Tarakasura engaged in a fierce battle with Mahakali and Veerbhadra.

videos.title: Episode 359
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura offered prayers to Goddess Tara for more powers after getting injured in a battle with Kartikeya.

videos.title: Episode 360
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura attacked Kartikeya after Goddess Tara answered his prayers and turned him into a powerful asura.

videos.title: Episode 361
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya struggled to kill Tarakasura and later got highly upset after finding out the reason behind it.

videos.title: Episode 362
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Tarakasura appeared scared after Kartikeya found out a way to put an end to him.

videos.title: Episode 363
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Kartikeya assumed the form of a ferocious snake to battle Tarakasura's humongous form, while Goddess Parvati and other gods eagerly awaited the outcome of the fight.

videos.title: Episode 364
videos.overview: After offering prayers to Goddess Skandamata, Kartikeya narrates the story of Lord Ganesha's birth and life. Following that, Lord Ganesha starts with the story of Goddess Adishakti's sixth form, Goddess Katyayani.

videos.title: Episode 365
videos.overview: After describing Goddess Adishakti's seventh form, Goddess Kalaratri, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya narrate the story of her eighth form, Goddess Mahagauri, to King Divodasa and Queen Sarla.

videos.title: Episode 366
videos.overview: While narrating the story of Goddess Mahagauri, Lord Ganesha mentions how Lord Shiva took a huge risk to make Goddess Parvati realize her true status by conveying to her that she no longer seemed divine to him, after which she left Mount Kailash.

videos.title: Episode 367
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Lord Ganesha narrates how Goddess Parvati tackled several obstacles while performing sadhana and finally attained her most divine form of Goddess Mahagauri.

videos.title: Episode 368
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Goddess Mahagauri decided to teach all the gods a lesson after they became arrogant about their powers. He adds that she defeated Vaayu Dev, leaving Indra infuriated.

videos.title: Episode 369
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha narrates how Goddess Mahagauri defeated Indra and other gods, after which they realized her true form and apologized for their mistake.

videos.title: Episode 370
videos.overview: On the last day of Navratri, Lord Ganesha completes the story of Goddess Adishakti's ninth form, Goddess Siddhidhatri. As King Divodasa regrets forcing Lord Shiva to depart from Kashi, Lord Vishnu comes up with a brilliant solution to the problem.

videos.title: Episode 371
videos.overview: Due to Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya's efforts, Lord Shiva re-enters Kashi and unites with Goddess Parvati's form, Goddess Vishalakshi. Blessed by Lord Shiva, Lord Ganesha acquires a new five-headed form, Heramba Ganpati.

videos.title: Episode 372
videos.overview: As Goddess Vishalakshi is the only woman who hasn't batted her eyelids for years, she is expected to kill Durgamasura. However, she first wants Lord Ganesha to free Veda Mata from Durgamasura's captivity.

videos.title: Episode 373
videos.overview: While Lord Ganesha is on his way to get Veda Mata released, he is attacked by Durgamasura's aide. However, she ends up getting subdued by the divine vibes emanating from the lamp in his hands.

videos.title: Episode 374
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha gets disappointed after the flame of the lamp given to him by Goddess Vishalakshi appears extinguished due to an asura's dark powers meant to mislead him and Mushak Ji.

videos.title: Episode 375
videos.overview: Shrunk to his tiniest form, Lord Ganesha distracts Durgamasura and his aides but avoids catching their eyes. His divine touch turns meat into a sweet-dish and wine into water. While the asuras marvel over it, he steals the key to Veda Mata's cell.

videos.title: Episode 376
videos.overview: Armed with Goddess Vishalakshi's divine lamp, Lord Ganesha chants some mantras and frees Veda Mata from the captivity of Durgamasura.

videos.title: Episode 377
videos.overview: After the release of Veda Mata, the gods regain their powers and plan to shoulder their responsibilities towards the universe. Meanwhile, Durgamasura uses his powers to cause drought all over the world.

videos.title: Episode 378
videos.overview: Goddess Parvati is unable to bear seeing the world suffering in pain due to the widespread drought. Her overflowing tears turn into water and revive the life on earth, after which Lord Shiva gives her the name, Shatakshi.

videos.title: Episode 379
videos.overview: Attacked by Durgamasura's minions, people lose hope as Goddess Parvati doesn't answer their prayers. Lord Shiva then reveals the reason behind Goddess Parvati's indifference to Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya.

videos.title: Episode 380
videos.overview: Disguised as Brahmins, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya advise the villagers to maintain cleanliness in their surroundings to avoid any further attacks from Durgamasura's aides.

videos.title: Episode 381
videos.overview: Though the earth is cleansed, mankind suffers due to a shortage of food supplies. Goddess Parvati then appears in the form of Goddess Shakumbhari and blesses the earth with abundant fruits and vegetables.

videos.title: Episode 382
videos.overview: Goddess Parvati sends Goddess Kaal Ratri to initiate a truce between Durgamasura and the gods. However, Durgamasura humiliates Goddess Kaal Ratri and asks her to bow down to him.

videos.title: Episode 383
videos.overview: To convince Durgamasura for the peace proposal, Goddess Kaal Ratri reminds him of his father's demise during his childhood. However, instead of considering her proposal, he orders his asuras to capture her.

videos.title: Episode 384
videos.overview: Intending to teach Durgamasura a lesson, Goddess Parvati seeks Lord Shiva's permission to leave for Mount Vindhyachal. Meanwhile, Arunasura threatens to snatch Durgamasura's throne from him.

videos.title: Episode 385
videos.overview: Arunasura takes all goddesses captive. Mata Adishakti says Arunasura, now soon you will die. Mata goes to fight Arunasura.

videos.title: Episode 386
videos.overview: On Mount Vindhyachal, Vinayaki, Maheshwari, Narayani, Kumarini and Brahmani awaken Goddess Parvati's form, Vindhyavasini. Meanwhile, Arunasura continues with his attacks on the gods.

videos.title: Episode 387
videos.overview: Hearing all the goddesses' prayers, Goddess Adishakti sets off from Mount Vindhyachal towards Swarg Lok. However, a secret boon granted by Lord Brahma to Arunasura proves to be a hindrance in her path.

videos.title: Episode 388
videos.overview: Shukracharya tests Jalandhar and sends him to a cave, where Jalandhar sees Vrinda. She turns out to be an illusion that tries to kill him and Shukracharya warns him that his wife will cause his death.

videos.title: Episode 389
videos.overview: After shattering Arunasura's faith in Goddess Gayatri, Lord Ganesha appears in his largest form to escape his trap before destroying the entire place and marching his way back.

videos.title: Episode 390
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha tries to reach out to Goddess Kalratri through his prayers to find out a way to kill Arunasura. Goddess Kalratri answers his prayers and offers to help him discover the truth about Lord Brahma's boon to Arunasura.

videos.title: Episode 391
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu turns into a clear pool of water while Lord Brahma becomes mud to make it murky for Lord Shiva's lotus form to bloom in it. Drawn towards the lotus, Goddess Adishakti assumes the form of Bhramari, destined to kill Arunasura.

videos.title: Episode 392
videos.overview: Goddess Adishakti's Bhramari form proceeds to attack Arunasura with her army of bees and wasps. However, she finds it difficult to fight his army of asuras.

videos.title: Episode 393
videos.overview: After defeating Arunasura's army, Goddess Bhramari and her army of bees and wasps are stuck due to another attack. Goddess Bhramari then offers prayers to Lord Ganesha to get rid of all the obstacles in her path.

videos.title: Episode 394
videos.overview: Mata Bhramari comes to kill Arunasura. a lizard demon pulls Mata using his tongue and says you cannot go anywhere filthy insect.

videos.title: Episode 395
videos.overview: Goddess Bhramari's attack on Arunasura leads to a massive explosion while Durgamasura keeps a close watch on their fight. She then summons her army of bees and wasps who cling to her body as she appears in her true form.

videos.title: Episode 396
videos.overview: Unable to get Goddess Bhramari to assume her normal divine form, Lord Ganesha prays to Lord Shiva for help. Once again, she gets lured by Lord Shiva's lotus form and both come back to their normal form.

videos.title: Episode 397
videos.overview: Goddess Nimavat, a form of Goddess Adishakti, is in tears as she regrets granting a boon to Durgamasura, who then decides to summon Mayasura. Meanwhile, Goddess Adishakti realises Durgamasura's intention to pit her against her own form.

videos.title: Episode 398
videos.overview: While Goddess Nimavat sheds tears regretting her mistake, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya try to find information on Mayasura's whereabouts from her. Following that, the duo sets out looking for Durgamasura and Mayasura.

videos.title: Episode 399
videos.overview: Impressed with Durgamasura's plan to defeat Goddess Adishakti, Arunasura agrees to join hands with him for the mission. Meanwhile, Kartikeya and Lord Ganesha try to find their way to reach Durgamasura and Arunasura.

videos.title: Episode 400
videos.overview: While Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya try to trace Durgamasura's location with the help of Mushak Ji, Mayasura visits Naaglok and tries to manipulate the Naags into fighting against Goddess Adishakti.

videos.title: Episode 401
videos.overview: While Goddess Vindhyavasini narrates a story about Goddess Kadru, mother of all Naags, and the latter's sister Goddess Vinta to Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya, Mayasura manipulates the facts of the same story to turn the Naags against all the gods.

videos.title: Episode 402
videos.overview: Goddess Vindhyavasini advises Lord Ganesha to break Mayasura's spell and get all the Naags freed. Meanwhile, under the spell, Sheshnaag's wife ends up putting her own egg in danger and attacks her husband.

videos.title: Episode 403
videos.overview: Just like Naaglakshmi and other Naags, Sheshnaag also ends up getting trapped in Mayasura's spell. Meanwhile, the couple's egg hatches and Lord Ganesha takes his 'Lambodara' avatar to help all the Naags.

videos.title: Episode 404
videos.overview: In the form of 'Lambodara', Lord Ganesha uses his powers to hypnotize Mayasura and frees Sheshnaag from the spell. While Sheshnaag rushes to help his wife and other Naags, Lord Ganesha continues to fight Mayasura.

videos.title: Episode 405
videos.overview: Due to Durgamasura's sadhana, Sheshnaag is unable to revive most of the serpents of his clan. Meanwhile, in his Lambodara avatar, Lord Ganesha swallows the entire Brahmalok when he is not allowed to capture Mayasura.

videos.title: Episode 406
videos.overview: In his Lambodara avatar, Lord Ganesha proves that the universe exists within his stomach and frees Lord Brahma from Mayasura's spell. Following that, he kills Mayasura.

videos.title: Episode 407
videos.overview: While Durgamasura assembles his army and starts the procedure to appoint a commander, Goddess Vindhyavasini and other gods discuss their battle strategy.

videos.title: Episode 408
videos.overview: While Goddess Adishakti and other goddesses offer prayers to Lord Shiva, Durgamasura learns that she won't be able to use her weapons for the next three days and decides to capitalize on it.

videos.title: Episode 409
videos.overview: With the help of his army, Durgamasura tries to distract Lord Ganesha and other gods while one of his aides, Ganasura, secretly heads towards Mount Vindhyachal to attack Goddess Adishakti.

videos.title: Episode 410
videos.overview: While Kartikeya and other gods deal with the asura army, Lord Ganesha tries to prevent Ganasura from reaching Goddess Adishakti and other goddesses.

videos.title: Episode 411
videos.overview: While Goddess Adishakti bathes the shivling on Mount Vindhyachal, Lord Shiva gets drenched in rain on Mount Kailash. On the other hand, Lord Ganesha leaves no stone unturned in his efforts to prevent Ganasura from reaching Mount Vindhyachal.

videos.title: Episode 412
videos.overview: While Goddess Adishakti completes the first day of her ritual without any disturbance, the gods and asuras plan their future course of action in their respective camps.

videos.title: Episode 413
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya hatch an ingenious plan to find out a way to defeat the asura commanders before the beginning of the second day of their battle.

videos.title: Episode 414
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha, Kartikeya and other gods are dumbfounded when none of their weapons cause any harm to the asura commanders. Meanwhile, Durgamasura tries to reach Goddess Adishakti but is unable to get past the divine protective shield.

videos.title: Episode 415
videos.overview: Durgamasura attacks the Gopikas to cut off the milk supply meant for Goddess Adishakti's worship ritual. As a result, a furious Lord Shiva performs 'tandav', which causes tremors across the universe.

videos.title: Episode 416
videos.overview: Goddess Vindhyavasini appears on the battlefield along with many other goddesses to fight Durgamasura, who tries to demean her by expressing his male supremacist views.

videos.title: Episode 417
videos.overview: A fierce battle ensues between all the goddesses and the commanders of Durgamasura's army. Meanwhile, Lord Ganesha approaches the goddesses one by one to share vital information that might help them defeat the asuras.

videos.title: Episode 418
videos.overview: With all his commanders defeated, Durgamasura battles with Goddess Adishakti and her avatars, who try to put an end to his life. Irked by this, he asks her to fight by herself instead of sending her several avatars to the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 419
videos.overview: Assuming the form of Goddess Vishalakshi, who never blinks, Goddess Durga puts an end to Durgamasura. All the gods then offer prayers to her.

videos.title: Episode 420
videos.overview: After Goddess Parvati returns to Mount Kailash, Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya plan to celebrate her birthday. However, Lord Ganesha fears the emergence of a threat considering the history of all celebrations in their family.

videos.title: Episode 421
videos.overview: After Kartikeya narrates the significance of Lord Shiva's 'Ashtamurti' to Lord Ganesha, Kuber reveals how he became the protector of universal wealth from a petty thief, and Goddess Laxmi discloses how she earned her position in Lord Vishnu's heart.

videos.title: Episode 422
videos.overview: On Lord Ganesha's request, Lord Vishnu narrates the story of how he sacrificed his organs to please Lord Shiva, that starts with asuras Dushanantha and Jayanantha's desire to conquer heaven.

videos.title: Episode 423
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu narrates how he was presented with a strong weapon, 'Sudarshana Chakra', after Lord Shiva got pleased with his devotion and sacrifice. He then reveals how he used that weapon to defeat Dushanantha and Jayanantha.

videos.title: Episode 424
videos.overview: In order to convince Lord Shiva to move to the kingdom of Lanka, Dashanand arrives at Mount Kailash and ends up in an altercation with Nandi.

videos.title: Episode 425
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya are amazed when they learn how Goddess Parvati managed to avoid going to Lanka with Dashanand by tricking him into marrying Mandodari, a cursed frog that turned into a beautiful woman.

videos.title: Episode 426
videos.overview: Unable to have a darshan of Lord Shiva, Dashanand tries to uproot Mount Kailash till his hands begin to bleed. Pleased with his devotion, Lord Shiva names him Raavan and is forced to give him the 'Atmalinga' to take it to Lanka.

videos.title: Episode 427
videos.overview: Carrying Lord Shiva's 'Atmalinga' in his hands, Raavan walks towards Lanka. Meanwhile, Lord Ganesha tries several means to prevent him from accomplishing his journey.

videos.title: Episode 428
videos.overview: Walking towards Lanka with the 'Atmalinga' in his hands and Lord Ganesha alongside, Raavan narrates the story of Lord Shiva's nine avatars starting with that of Piplaad and mentions how Shani played an important role in it.

videos.title: Episode 429
videos.overview: While Raavan narrates the story of Shani's birth, Lord Ganesha tries to trick him into keeping the 'Atmalinga' on the ground but in vain.

videos.title: Episode 430
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Shani fought for the rights of his mother, Chhaya, who was also Suryadev's estranged second wife. He adds that Shani demonstrated his powers by extracting all the brightness from Suryadev, causing darkness in the universe.

videos.title: Episode 431
videos.overview: Continuing with the story, Raavan narrates how Chhaya got her rights after Lord Shiva restored Suryadev's brightness, and speaks about Manda's entry into a grown-up Shani's life.

videos.title: Episode 432
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Shani was infuriated after Chhaya, who was created from the shadow of Suryadev's first wife Sangya, was ordered to remerge into the latter.

videos.title: Episode 433
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Shani resolved to acquire a position higher than that of his father Suryadev after Chhaya was forced to remerge into Sangya as the latter's shadow.

videos.title: Episode 434
videos.overview: Raavan narrates to Lord Ganesha how Shani pleased Lord Shiva with his prayers to acquire a life-changing boon after getting cursed by his newlywed wife Manda.

videos.title: Episode 435
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Shani became the god of justice and his inauspicious gaze was about to affect the lives of Indra and Sage Dadhichi, who was destined to become the father of Lord Shiva's first avatar Piplaad.

videos.title: Episode 436
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Indra started taking wrong decisions and a series of unfortunate incidents took place in his life after Shani's inauspicious gaze fell on him.

videos.title: Episode 437
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Sage Dadhichi hid Indra and other gods' divine weapons within his body while Lord Ganesha tackled the asuras.

videos.title: Episode 438
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Indra made yet another wrong decision to replace Sage Brihaspati with Sage Vishwaroop as the new 'Devguru' but ended up killing the latter instead.

videos.title: Episode 439
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Sage Dadhichi was expected to sacrifice his life to help Indra and other gods fight against Vritra, a demon unleashed on them by Sage Vishwaroop's father Sage Twashta.

videos.title: Episode 440
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva's first avatar Piplaad ended up getting abandoned right after birth while the latter's mother was devastated by the recent death of her husband Sage Dadhichi.

videos.title: Episode 441
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Indra killed Vritra using his most powerful weapon Vajra, made from the ashes of Sage Dadhichi. Following that, he continues with the story of how Piplaad survived by himself under a peepul tree by consuming its leaves.

videos.title: Episode 442
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Piplaad resolved to punish Shani for doing him an injustice after learning why the former had been living as an orphan.

videos.title: Episode 443
videos.overview: While narrating the story of Piplaad's eventful journey towards Shani's abode, Raavan staggers for a moment due to a smart move played by Lord Ganesha to ensure that he drops the 'Atmalinga' on the ground.

videos.title: Episode 444
videos.overview: Much to Lord Ganesha's disappointment, Raavan regains his balance and does not drop the 'Atmalinga' on the ground. He then narrates how Surya Dev stood in Piplaad's way to prevent the latter from reaching Shani's abode.

videos.title: Episode 445
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Piplaad cried in pain after Rahu and Ketu trapped him and mentally tortured him to drive him away from Shani's abode. He adds how the duo soon realized that Piplaad was never trapped and used their spell on them to trick them.

videos.title: Episode 446
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Piplaad overcame several obstacles to reach Shani and threatened to punish the latter for being unjust and cruel to him.

videos.title: Episode 447
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Piplaad made Shani realize his mistake and suggested some major changes in the latter's justice system as a punishment.

videos.title: Episode 448
videos.overview: After Raavan narrates how Piplaad gave Shani the name Shaneshwara, Lord Ganesha plays a move to retrieve the 'Atmalinga' from him.

videos.title: Episode 449
videos.overview: Raavan narrates the story of Sage Shilada, who was destined to be the father of Lord Shiva's second avatar Nandi.

videos.title: Episode 450
videos.overview: While narrating the story of Sage Shilada's efforts to create a new heaven, Raavan mentions how Sage Vishwamitra tried to create a parallel universe for Trishanku, Lord Rama's ancestor.

videos.title: Episode 451
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Sage Shilada acquired a boon to have Lord Shiva's second avatar as his son after avoiding repeating Sage Vishwamitra's mistake of creating another heaven.

videos.title: Episode 452
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how people mocked Nandi and refused to believe that he was Lord Shiva's avatar assuming that he was not in his right mind. He adds that things changed after Nandi encountered Goddess Parvati and other gods in a forest.

videos.title: Episode 453
videos.overview: Indra and other gods disguise themselves to test Nandi on several parameters to decide if the latter is capable of becoming Lord Shiva's friend and vehicle.

videos.title: Episode 454
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Nandi meditated relentlessly for years to prove his worth and managed to please Lord Shiva with his devotion.

videos.title: Episode 455
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Brahma became arrogant and tried to cheat Lord Shiva to establish his supremacy over Lord Vishnu. He adds that Lord Shiva then grew furious and incarnated himself as Bhairava to teach Lord Brahma a lesson.

videos.title: Episode 456
videos.overview: While Raavan narrates the story of Lord Shiva's third avatar Bhairava to Lord Ganesha, Nandi tries to convince the latter's friends from Mount Kailash to help him ensure that the 'Atmalinga' does not get taken away to Lanka.

videos.title: Episode 457
videos.overview: Nandi and his friends struggle to get Raavan to drop the 'Atmalinga' on the ground before he can reach Lanka. Meanwhile, Raavan continues narrating the story of Lord Shiva's fourth avatar Veerbhadra.

videos.title: Episode 458
videos.overview: While narrating the story of Lord Shiva's fourth avatar Veerbhadra, Raavan explains the significance of worshipping the holy peepul tree. Lord Ganesha points out the differences between the banyan tree and the peepul tree.

videos.title: Episode 459
videos.overview: Raavan not only prevents the 'Atmalinga' from falling on the ground but also manages to regain his hold on it. While Nandi and Shringi use the power of fire to defeat him, he narrates the story of Lord Shiva's avatar, Grihapati, to Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 460
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva was pleased with Sage Vishwanar and Shuchismati's prayers, and granted the couple a boon to have his next avatar Grihapati as their son.

videos.title: Episode 461
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Grihapati relentlessly offered prayers to Lord Shiva to free himself from Agnidev's curse, according to which he was destined to lose his life at the age of thirteen.

videos.title: Episode 462
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva freed Grihapati from Agnidev's deadly curse and gave the name 'Agnishwar' to the Shivling made by him.

videos.title: Episode 463
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva instructed Veerbhadra to pacify Lord Vishnu's avatar, Narsimha, who was unable to control his anger after killing Hiranyakashyapu.

videos.title: Episode 464
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva incarnated himself as the part-lion and part-bird beast Sharabha to tame the part-lion and part-human avatar of Lord Vishnu, Narsimha, after Veerbhadra failed to accomplish the task.

videos.title: Episode 465
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how the fight between Sharabha and Narsimha had a catastrophic effect on the universe, due to which a worried Goddess Parvati started offering prayers to Mahaganpati for help.

videos.title: Episode 466
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva incarnated himself as Brahmachari to test Goddess Parvati, who was his wife Goddess Sati in her previous life.

videos.title: Episode 467
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva's next avatar Sunatnartak appeared to put forth his marriage proposal for Goddess Parvati before her father Himavan.

videos.title: Episode 468
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Himavan, who was unaware that Sunatnartak is Lord Shiva's avatar, grew furious at the idea of getting Goddess Parvati married to him.

videos.title: Episode 469
videos.overview: After completing the story of Sunatnartak, Raavan narrates how little Upmanyu was about to play an important role in the appearance of Lord Shiva's next avatar Sureshwar.

videos.title: Episode 470
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Goddess Parvati assumed the form of Kamdhenu and brought milk to test little Upmanyu, who was offering prayers to Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Episode 471
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Upmanyu passed several tests and gave the name Sureshwar to Lord Shiva, who appeared in the form of Indra to punish him.

videos.title: Episode 472
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva appeared in his true form along with Nandi and Goddess Parvati before blessing Upmanyu with an ocean of milk.

videos.title: Episode 473
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Goddess Parvati, Goddess Lakshmi and Goddess Saraswati asked their respective husbands to test Anusuya, who was destined to be the mother of Lord Shiva's avatar, Sage Durvasa.

videos.title: Episode 474
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Brahma, Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva offered to incarnate themselves as Anusuya's sons after she successfully passed the test they put her through.

videos.title: Episode 475
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Sage Durvasa, Chandraatri and Dattatreya were born to Anusuya to accomplish a special purpose.

videos.title: Episode 476
videos.overview: River Ganga appears in her divine form and narrates to Lord Ganesha and Raavan how Sage Durvasa cursed her for playing an innocent prank on him during her childhood.

videos.title: Episode 477
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Indra and other gods lost all their wealth after Sage Durvasa cursed them for being too arrogant and irresponsible.

videos.title: Episode 478
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva became 'Neelkanth', the one with a blue throat, after consuming all the poison that was extracted as a result of the process of churning of the ocean by the gods and asuras.

videos.title: Episode 479
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva got the name Chandrashekhar for wearing the moon as his crown after it was extracted as a result of the churning process.

videos.title: Episode 480
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Vishnu incarnated himself as Mohini, who tricked the asuras into letting her serve all the elixir of immortality to the gods.

videos.title: Episode 481
videos.overview: Raavan, Lord Ganesha and Mushak Ji discuss how Lord Shiva in the form of hermit Avadhut punished Indra for being arrogant. The trio also talks about how all the gods felt embarrassed about accompanying Lord Ganesha to Lord Vishnu's wedding.

videos.title: Episode 482
videos.overview: Mushak Ji narrates how his team of rats taught all the gods a lesson while Lord Vishnu and Goddess Laxmi offered prayers to Lord Ganesha before proceeding with their wedding.

videos.title: Episode 483
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how a bigger problem awaited Lord Vishnu after his wedding with Goddess Laxmi took place uninterruptedly.

videos.title: Episode 484
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Goddess Laxmi's five sisters offered prayers to Lord Vishnu to please him so that their wish to have the latter as their husband can be fulfilled.

videos.title: Episode 485
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Vishnu ended up staying over with Goddess Laxmi's five sisters after blessing them with a child each.

videos.title: Episode 486
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva's next avatar Vrishabh, a bull, faced several obstacles during his mission to bring Lord Vishnu back from the palace of the five goddesses.

videos.title: Episode 487
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how the five goddesses put forth a condition according to which Lord Shiva's Vrishabh avatar must defeat their five sons in a battle to take Lord Vishnu back to his abode.

videos.title: Episode 488
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how the five goddesses lost their respective sons in the battle against Lord Shiva. He adds that the goddesses then tried to get Lord Vishnu to fight Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Episode 489
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva was left with no option other than engaging in a duel with Lord Vishnu as the latter failed to recollect his past.

videos.title: Episode 490
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Nabhag made it clear that he only wants his father King Shradhdev as his share of the inheritance, leaving his eight greedy brothers surprised.

videos.title: Episode 491
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Nabhag's participation in a yajna being conducted by a group of sages called Angiras led to Lord Shiva incarnating himself as Krishna Darshan.

videos.title: Episode 492
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva incarnated himself as Bhikshuvarya, a beggar, and advised a beggarwoman to raise an orphan baby from a royal family.

videos.title: Episode 493
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Dharmagupt got to know his life story from Bhikshuvarya and ended up getting married to King Naresh's daughter.

videos.title: Episode 494
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva appeared in the form of Yaksha, also known as Yaksheshwar, to teach Indra and other gods a lesson for being too arrogant.

videos.title: Episode 495
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how a poor hunter couple living in a village played a crucial role in the story of Lord Shiva's sixteenth avatar Yatinath.

videos.title: Episode 496
videos.overview: Raavan narrates how Lord Shiva's avatar Yatinath revealed his true identity to the poor hunter couple and granted them a boon, according to which they will be reborn as King Nal and Queen Damayanti.

videos.title: Episode 497
videos.overview: As a result of drinking too much water, Raavan is forced to consider taking a bathroom break. Subsequently, he sees a monk passing by and contemplates handing the atmalinga to him.

videos.title: Episode 498
videos.overview: Disguised as a monk, Lord Ganesha places the atmalinga on the ground before Raavan can take it to Lanka. Consequently, Raavan tries to uproot it, due to which the universe is put in danger.

videos.title: Episode 499
videos.overview: While Raavan voices his displeasure over being tricked into losing the atmalinga, Lord Ganesha tries to make him realize his mistake by reminding him of all the teachings conveyed through the stories of Lord Shiva's avatars.

videos.title: Episode 500
videos.overview: Lord Shiva announces that Gokarna, the place where the atmalinga was installed, will be a pilgrim spot. Meanwhile, Lord Ganesha gives the name Mahabaleshwar Mahadev to the atmalinga.

videos.title: Episode 501
videos.overview: While his family is busy enjoying Himavat's hospitality, Lord Ganesha feels disturbed as he keeps having some strange visions. With several questions popping up in his mind, he contemplates sharing his problem with Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Episode 502
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha finds himself in a fix as everyone in his family ignores his questions while conducting his abhisheka. Subsequently, he longs for a friend who might help him find answers.

videos.title: Episode 503
videos.overview: Longing for a friend, Lord Ganesha follows the ashes to a distant place. Subsequently, he ends up giving the ashes a form, leading to the birth of Bhanda Kumar.

videos.title: Episode 504
videos.overview: Bhanda Kumar demonstrates his cruelty to Lord Ganesha by plucking a flower and subsequently destroying it. Lord Ganesha then tries to teach him the difference between good and evil.

videos.title: Episode 505
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha reprimands Bhanda Kumar for ignoring the former's teachings and gobbling up an innocent parrot to satiate the latter's hunger. Subsequently, he advises Bhanda Kumar to accept his wrongdoings and apologize for it.

videos.title: Episode 506
videos.overview: When Bhanda Kumar tries to sit on Lord Shiva's meditation spot, Lord Ganesha grows furious and decides to punish him. To save himself from the punishment, Bhanda Kumar offers to meditate to please Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Episode 507
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha grows restless as he continues to have strange visions, following which he seeks his parents' help to find answers to the questions popping up in his mind. He also narrates to them how he created Bhanda Kumar.

videos.title: Episode 508
videos.overview: Lord Shiva narrates to Lord Ganesha how Hayagriva acquired the Vedas for himself, following which Lord Vishnu jumped into action to protect the universe from its repercussions.

videos.title: Episode 509
videos.overview: Lord Shiva narrates to Lord Ganesha how Lord Vishnu's divine Hayagriva form came into existence to fight Hayagriva, the demon.

videos.title: Episode 510
videos.overview: As advised by Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, Lord Ganesha sets out to look for Lord Vishnu's divine Hayagriva form to find answers to all the questions on his mind.

videos.title: Episode 511
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu's divine Hayagriva form narrates the stories of Lobhasura, a demon born due to Kuber's greed, and Mamtasura, another asura born due to Goddess Parvati's maternal instinct and anger.

videos.title: Episode 512
videos.overview: Lord Vishnu's Hayagriva form makes Lord Ganesha realize that the latter made a big mistake by creating Bhanda Kumar, who is busy praying to Lord Shiva to become powerful.

videos.title: Episode 513
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha comes up with a plan to trap Lobhasura with some help from Goddess Laxmi and Kuber. Meanwhile, Lobhasura thinks of what he should ask for from the divine wish-granting tree, Kalpavriksha.

videos.title: Episode 514
videos.overview: Lobhasura evades Lord Ganesha and Karthikeya's attacks and flees with half of Kuber's wealth. However, Lord Ganesha is certain that Lobhasura will return to steal the rest of the wealth that he left behind.

videos.title: Episode 515
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha, Kartikeya and Kuber must crack some tricky riddles to retrieve Kamdhenu, Kalpavriksha and other heavenly belongings stolen by Lobhasura.

videos.title: Episode 516
videos.overview: Lobhasura is confident that Lord Ganesha will never be able to solve the riddles and will remain busy with it till Bhanda Kumar completes his meditation to please Lord Shiva and acquire more power.

videos.title: Episode 517
videos.overview: With some help from Kuber, Kartikeya and Mushak, Ganesha solves the riddle to locate Lobhasura. Subsequently, they conclude that Lobhasura can be found in a place inhabited by snakes.

videos.title: Episode 518
videos.overview: After successfully tracing Lobhasura's location, Lord Ganesha confronts him in a duel. Subsequently, he hatches a plan to retrieve all the stolen divine objects from Lobhasura.

videos.title: Episode 519
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha, in his Gajanan form, teaches a lesson to Lobhasura by defeating him and retrieving all the stolen items from him.

videos.title: Episode 520
videos.overview: After his battle with Lord Ganesha, Lobhasura realizes that he must never succumb to his greed. Subsequently, he feels confused about the purpose of his life and seeks guidance from Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 521
videos.overview: Lord Hayagriva explains to Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya how Kaamasura and Raavan were responsible for Vedvati's decision to sacrifice her life. Subsequently, he narrates how the gods sent Menaka over to stop Vishwamitra from continuing his meditation.

videos.title: Episode 522
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya come up with a plan to get past the protective shield around Kaamasura. Subsequently, Lord Ganesha appears in his 'Vikata' avatar.

videos.title: Episode 523
videos.overview: 'Vikata' Ganesha stands still as Kaamasura shoots his most powerful weapons towards the former. Consequently, Kartikeya intervenes but fails to tackle the attack.

videos.title: Episode 524
videos.overview: In order to counter Kaamasura's powerful attacks, Vikata Ganesha shoots his divine weapon towards him. Consequently, Kaamasura gets tied up and is unable to free himself despite using all his strength.

videos.title: Episode 525
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya are left helpless when Goddess Parvati forbids them from attacking Mamtasura. To add to their woes, she presents Mamtasura with a powerful weapon for his protection.

videos.title: Episode 526
videos.overview: Mamtasura hatches a sinister plan to get rid of Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya. He is left disappointed when the duo escapes unhurt.

videos.title: Episode 527
videos.overview: Due to the influence of Mamtasura's spell, Kaikesi condones Ravana's wrongdoings. Subsequently, she advises him to ignore his wife Mandodari's warnings regarding his disrespectful attitude towards women.

videos.title: Episode 528
videos.overview: Under Mamtasura's spell, Hanuman commits a blunder, due to which the latter gets cursed by a sage. Consequently, he forgets how to use his divine powers.

videos.title: Episode 529
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Kartikeya fail to attack Mamtasura as the latter is protected by the Yogini goddesses sent by Goddess Parvati. Consequently, the duo conspires to fuel Goddess Parvati's anger against Mamtasura.

videos.title: Episode 530
videos.overview: Mamtasura finds himself in trouble after Goddess Parvati decides to punish him for his misdeeds. His blood runs cold when she angrily advances towards him and begins thrashing him.

videos.title: Episode 531
videos.overview: With Sheshnag's help, Lord Ganesha appears in the form of Vighnaraj to punish Mamtasura. Following an intense battle, a defeated Mamtasura repents for his misdeeds and offers prayers to Vighnaraj Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 532
videos.overview: Pleased with Bhandasura's devotion, Lord Shiva appears before him to grant him a boon. Meanwhile, all other gods worry about the possible consequences that this turn of events will have on the universe.

videos.title: Episode 533
videos.overview: All the gods helplessly watch in disbelief as Bhandasura uses his powers to create his two brothers, a sister, four wives and eight children. Subsequently, he decides to finalize a place of residence for himself and his family.

videos.title: Episode 534
videos.overview: Shukracharya summons the entire asura clan to coronate Bhandasura as their new king. Before the commencement of the rituals, Bhandasura seeks blessings from Lord Ganesha and Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Episode 535
videos.overview: Goddess Parvati loses her temper over the possibility of Bhandasura wreaking havoc in the universe by misusing the powers granted to him by Lord Shiva. Meanwhile, Bhandasura orders his aides to establish his rule across all the galaxies.

videos.title: Episode 536
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha tries to get Bhandasura to deviate from his principles to initiate the latter's downfall. However, all his efforts go in vain.

videos.title: Episode 537
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha and Lord Vishnu hatch a plan to initiate Bhandasura's downfall. They send an attractive woman called Vimohini to his palace to accomplish their purpose.

videos.title: Episode 538
videos.overview: Tricked by Vimohini, a heartbroken Bhandasura decides to attack the gods, who in turn pray to Goddess Parashakti for help against him.

videos.title: Episode 539
videos.overview: Unable to attack the gods, Bhandasura prays to Lord Ganesha to get rid of all the obstacles in his path. However, Lord Ganesha tries to deceive Bhandasura in order to protect the gods from him.

videos.title: Episode 540
videos.overview: Bhandasura's aides fail to understand why all the gods are missing from their abodes. Meanwhile, Lord Ganesha gears up to offer prayers to Goddess Parashakti as per Mahaganpati's instructions.

videos.title: Episode 541
videos.overview: Goddess Parashakti appears before the gods in her divine form after they all cut off their respective left arms as an offering in the yajna being performed to summon her.

videos.title: Episode 542
videos.overview: As per Lord Ganesha's suggestion, Goddess Parashakti considers getting married to Lord Adi Mahadev. The couple assumes the form of Goddess Kaameshwari and Lord Madan Kaameshwar respectively before the commencement of the rituals.

videos.title: Episode 543
videos.overview: Goddess Parashakti's avatar, Lalita, creates a massive army of powerful goddesses to fight against Bhandasura and other asuras. Meanwhile, Lord Ganesha describes the significance of the goddesses and their three huge chariots.

videos.title: Episode 544
videos.overview: Accompanied by her massive army on three huge chariots, Goddess Parashakti's avatar, Lalita, is all set to fight the asuras. Meanwhile, Bhandasura considers sending his weakest soldiers to the battlefield to test the waters.

videos.title: Episode 545
videos.overview: Kurund tries to avenge his brother's death by launching fierce attacks on the army of goddesses. Subsequently, Goddess Lalita sends Goddess Kautuka to tackle him.

videos.title: Episode 546
videos.overview: Goddess Shyamala owns the battlefield by destroying two asuras. Subsequently, Bhandasura gets so mesmerized by Goddess Lalita's divinity that he unwittingly proceeds to fold hands before her. However, he suddenly regains his senses and stops.

videos.title: Episode 547
videos.overview: Unable to get over how he felt drawn towards Goddess Parashakti, Bhandasura grows curious about her. Subsequently, he seeks answers to his questions from Sage Shukracharya.

videos.title: Episode 548
videos.overview: After learning the truth about Goddess Parashakti and her powers, Bhandasura decides to organize a prayer ritual to please Lord Ganesha. Subsequently, he comes up with a new battle strategy.

videos.title: Episode 549
videos.overview: Bhandasura's plan to destroy the goddesses with the help of his army of snakes hits a snag when Goddess Nakula brings mongooses to tackle them on the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 550
videos.overview: Sarpini and Goddess Nakula fight an intense battle in the form of a snake and a mongoose respectively. Meanwhile, Bhandasura considers cutting off his tongue as an offering in his yajna to please Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 551
videos.overview: Unable to think of a way to get out of Bhandasura's palace, Lord Ganesha finds himself helpless. Meanwhile, seven asuras proceed to attack the goddesses.

videos.title: Episode 552
videos.overview: Bhandasura not only ensures that Lord Ganesha does not leave the palace but also offers prayers to summon Lord Shiva. Meanwhile, the goddesses try to tackle the asuras on the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 553
videos.overview: After the asura army faces a terrible defeat in a battle, Lord Ganesha advises Bhandasura to stop the war and apologize to Goddess Lalita. However, Bhandasura ignores it and keeps feeding modaks to Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 554
videos.overview: All the gods and goddesses in Goddess Parashakti's camp are busy singing praises and celebrating their victory. Meanwhile, Bhandasura gets emotional after meeting his daughter and shows her around his palace.

videos.title: Episode 555
videos.overview: Dhoomini forgets her mission to carry out a blast and gets distracted by Goddess Lalita's divine presence on the chariot. Meanwhile, Bhandasura's daughter tries to offer flowers to Goddess Lalita as per Lord Ganesha's instructions.

videos.title: Episode 556
videos.overview: Bhandasura holds his scared daughter in his arms and tries to protect her from the blast as well as its aftermath. Meanwhile, Goddess Lalita orders her army to refrain from attacking him.

videos.title: Episode 557
videos.overview: Bhandasura's daughter tells Lord Ganesha how she saw Goddess Lalita but couldn't ask for her earrings due to all the chaos. Meanwhile, with some help from Patange, Mushak flies towards Bhandasura's palace to help Lord Ganesha.

videos.title: Episode 558
videos.overview: Bhandasura decides to send a group of ferocious asuras to fight Baal Tripura Sundari, an eight-year-old goddess chosen by Goddess Lalita for that particular battle.

videos.title: Episode 559
videos.overview: Goddess Baal Tripura Sundari takes on several asuras in a battle, causing tremors all over the place. Meanwhile, Mushak saves Bhandasura's daughter from a mishap.

videos.title: Episode 560
videos.overview: Bhandasura's daughter joins hands with Mushak to help Lord Ganesha. Meanwhile, Baal Tripura Sundari gives all the asuras a tough time on the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 561
videos.overview: Bhandasura's daughter helps Mushak reach the room allotted to Lord Ganesha in the palace. Meanwhile, Goddess Baal Tripura Sundari uses the powerful 'Narayan Astra' against the asuras on the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 562
videos.overview: Mushak plays a clever move to prevent Lord Ganesha from being forced to consume any more modaks at Bhandasura's palace. Subsequently, Bhandasura's daughter helps Mushak to get Lord Ganesha off his seat.

videos.title: Episode 563
videos.overview: Due to the effect of the 'Vighnakarta Yantra', all the goddesses begin to feel weak and disoriented. Meanwhile, Bhandasura plans to strengthen his position by pleasing Lord Shiva.

videos.title: Episode 564
videos.overview: Locked in Bhandasura's palace, Lord Ganesha hears Mayura's voice and realizes that Kartikeya has come to rescue him. Meanwhile, the goddesses keep struggling against the asuras due to the 'Vighnakarta Yantra'.

videos.title: Episode 565
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha tries every trick in the book to destroy the 'Vighnakarta Yantra' while Bhandasura is forced to consider stopping the war as suggested by his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 566
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha, in the form of 'Ashtaganesha', helps strengthen the goddesses' position in the battle. Consequently, Bhandasura grows restless and considers fighting him despite being a devotee.

videos.title: Episode 567
videos.overview: Unable to please Lord Shiva, Bhandasura begins to question his strength and abilities. Meanwhile, Goddess Lalita explains to her listeners why Bhandasura could not win against the goddesses.

videos.title: Episode 568
videos.overview: Unable to win against the goddesses, Bhandasura seeks Shukracharya's guidance. His meeting proves to be fruitful as Shukracharya hands him something that can be used to bring a dead person back to life.

videos.title: Episode 569
videos.overview: The goddesses grow restless as they are unable to finish off Bhandasura's army despite killing the asuras in huge numbers. Subsequently, Lord Ganesha finds out the reason behind it and infers that Bhandasura is up to no good.

videos.title: Episode 570
videos.overview: While the day comes to an end, Lord Ganesha decides to find out what is Bhandasura's plan. Meanwhile, Bhandasura faces the deadliest of obstacles on his way to accomplish a mission.

videos.title: Episode 571
videos.overview: Desperate to find a way to defeat the army of goddesses, Bhandasura sees a ray of hope after completing his mission to meet his ancestors. However, the solution offered by them puts him in a tight spot as it requires him to make a huge sacrifice.

videos.title: Episode 572
videos.overview: Lord Ganesha is disappointed in Bhandasura over his decision to sacrifice the latter's daughter Rashmiprabha to secure his victory in the war against the goddesses.

videos.title: Episode 573
videos.overview: Bhandasura narrates a story to manipulate Rashmiprabha into believing that she must sacrifice herself to put an end to the war as well as to protect him and his kingdom. However, he gets emotional when she readily agrees to lay down her life for him.

videos.title: Episode 574
videos.overview: While Bhandasura feels a sense of accomplishment after acquiring a powerful weapon by sacrificing his daughter, his guru Shukracharya tries to make him realize that he is on the wrong path.

videos.title: Episode 575
videos.overview: Bhandasur is ready to risk losing Lord Shiva and Lord Ganesha to win against Goddess Parashakti. Armed with his deadliest weapon, he marches towards the battlefield.

videos.title: Episode 576
videos.overview: Attacked by Bhandasura's weapon, the goddesses age prematurely and contract several diseases. Consequently, Goddess Lalita tries to protect her army by reversing the effects of his weapon on them.

videos.title: Episode 577
videos.overview: Lord Shiva appears on the battlefield to help the army of goddesses against Bhandasura after Goddess Lalita summons him by chanting the 'Mahamrityunjaya Mantra'.

videos.title: Episode 578
videos.overview: After learning how Lord Ganesha helped Goddess Parashakti and the other goddesses, Bhandasura loses his temper. Subsequently, he tries to prove that Lord Ganesha is not as wise as everyone claims he is.

videos.title: Episode 579
